title: Moral Legitimacy and Market Exit Strategies: How Home-Country Consumers Evaluate Firm Responses to Economic Sanctions
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Moral Legitimacy and Market Exit Strategies: How Home-Country Consumers Evaluate Firm Responses to Economic Sanctions
detail.abstract: Economic sanctions are increasingly used as tools of international norm enforcement, yet little is known about how home-country consumers evaluate firms' strategic responses to such measures. This research examines how different market exit strategies from sanctioned host countries affect home-country consumers' legitimacy judgments and support for firms. Drawing on legitimacy theory and research in international business, we develop and test a framework to explain how home-country consumers respond to full, partial, and no-exit strategies. Across four studies using longitudinal secondary and experimental methods, we find that home-country consumers react more positively to firms that pursue full exit from a sanctioned market than to those that adopt partial or no exit strategies. Individual-level differences in susceptibility to normative influence, cognitive empathy, individualism, and ethical views on the use of sanctions shape these evaluations. The findings contribute to theories of legitimacy, international divestment, and moral stakeholder evaluation, and offer practical guidance to firms navigating the complexities of operating under economic sanctions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了母国消费者如何评估企业对经济制裁的不同市场退出策略（完全退出、部分退出、不退出），发现消费者对完全退出制裁市场的企业反应最积极，个体差异因素影响这些评价。
AI.research_question: 母国消费者如何评估企业对经济制裁的不同市场退出策略（完全退出、部分退出、不退出）？这些策略如何影响消费者对企业的合法性判断和支持？
AI.motivation: 经济制裁日益成为国际规范执行工具，但学界对母国消费者如何评估企业应对制裁的战略反应知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合法性理论、国际商务研究，构建了解释母国消费者对不同退出策略反应的框架。
AI.method: 四项研究，采用纵向二手数据和实验方法。
AI.findings: 母国消费者对完全退出制裁市场的企业反应最积极，优于部分退出或不退出策略；个体差异（规范性影响敏感性、认知同理心、个人主义、对制裁的伦理观点）影响评价。
AI.theory_contributions: 对合法性理论、国际撤资理论和道德利益相关者评价理论的贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在经济制裁环境下运营提供实践指导，帮助企业应对复杂的国际经营环境。

title: Customer Perceptions on Service Quality of Front Office Staff at Hotel
affiliations: and Velalar College of Engineering and Technology

detail.title: Customer Perceptions on Service Quality of Front Office Staff at Hotel
detail.abstract: All of the service businesses are trying their best to improve their service quality in order to make customers satisfied with their services, especially the hotel industry. If the service performance meets or exceeds customers' expectation, customers will be satisfied. On the other hand, customers are more likely to be dissatisfied if the service performance is less than what they have expected. Researches proved that service quality is an important element to make customers satisfied with the hotel services. The objectives of this study are to assess customers' expectation and perception level towards service quality of the front office staff in five dimensions: tangibility, reliability, responsiveness, assurance, and empathy (Parasuraman et al. 1988). SERVQUAL is used here as a tool to find the gap towards service quality of the front office staff in a hotel. Hotel management must seriously look in to key findings of research and take necessary steps to implement given suggestions to improve the service quality of front office at hotel. If the corrective actions on tangibility and reliability dimensions are taken, it is sure that it leads to improvement in service quality and it results in to customer satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用SERVQUAL模型评估酒店前厅服务质量，发现有形性和可靠性维度需改进，以提高客户满意度。
AI.research_question: 酒店前厅部门服务质量在五个SERVQUAL维度上的客户期望与实际感知层次如何？服务质量缺口在哪些方面？
AI.motivation: 服务质量是影响客户满意度的关键因素，酒店行业需要不断提升服务质量来满足客户期望。
AI.theoretical_framework: Parasuraman等人(1988)的SERVQUAL模型，包括五个维度：有形性、可靠性、响应性、保证性和关怀性
AI.method: 使用SERVQUAL工具进行调研，测量客户对酒店前厅服务质量的期望与实际感知层次
AI.findings: 发现有形性和可靠性两个维度存在服务质量缺口，需要重点改进
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了SERVQUAL模型在酒店前厅服务质量评估中的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店管理者提供了具体的服务质量改进建议，特别是在有形性和可靠性方面的改进措施

title: The Effect of Legalized Sports Betting on Convenience Store Lottery Sales
affiliations: and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: The Effect of Legalized Sports Betting on Convenience Store Lottery Sales
detail.abstract: In this study, we investigate the effect of sports betting legalization on convenience store lottery sales. We posit that there are two main relevant effects: (1) a substitution effect, which decreases lottery sales due to people substituting lotteries for sports betting, and (2) a spill-over effect, which increases lottery sales due to sports betting increasing people's taste for or addiction to gambling. Our main hypothesis is that online sports betting (OSB)'s effect on lottery sales is weakly more positive than the effect of retail sports betting (RSB). Our results lend support to this. Particularly, using a store-month panel dataset, we find that the launch of OSB led to a 17.3% increase in monthly lottery sales, and that the launch of RSB led to a 16.4% decrease in monthly lottery sales. This is consistent with the case where the spill-over effect dominates for OSB and the substitution effect dominates for RSB. For states that launched OSB and RSB during the same month, we find no significant effect on lottery sales, implying that the effects of OSB and RSB tend to cancel each other out. These findings could be useful to policymakers in evaluating the costs and benefits of legalizing sports betting, especially from a tax revenue standpoint.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨体育博彩合法化对便利店彩票销售的影响，发现线上体育博彩(OSB)使彩票销售增长17.3%，而零售体育博彩(RSB)使彩票销售下降16.4%，两种效应相互抵消。
AI.research_question: 体育博彩合法化如何影响便利店彩票销售？线上体育博彩和零售体育博彩的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 评估体育博彩合法化对现有彩票销售的影响，为政策制定者提供税收收入角度的成本效益分析依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代效应（减少彩票销售）和溢出效应（增加彩票销售）的理论框架，分析两种体育博彩形式的不同影响机制。
AI.method: 使用店铺-月度面板数据集，采用实证分析方法比较OSB和RSB启动前后彩票销售的变化。
AI.findings: OSB启动导致月度彩票销售增长17.3%（溢出效应主导），RSB启动导致下降16.4%（替代效应主导），两者同时启动时效应相互抵消。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同体育博彩形式对彩票销售的差异化影响机制，验证了替代效应和溢出效应的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估体育博彩合法化的税收影响提供实证依据，有助于制定更合理的博彩监管政策。

title: Impact of Sensory Marketing on Young Costumers with Reference to Starbucks

detail.title: Impact of Sensory Marketing on Young Costumers with Reference to Starbucks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Book Chapter (Ch. 16) titled “Impact Of Sensory Marketing On Young Customers With Reference To Starbucks,” in Emerging Paradigm in Management & Social Science, Weser Books, ISBN 978-3-96492-594-7, 2024.

detail.abstract: In recent years the topic of sensory marketing has attracted the attention of scholars and marketing researchers, putting a strong focus on how the stimulus influence customer decision, satisfaction and perceptions. The purpose of this study is to investigate the effect of sensory marketing on young customers with special reference to Starbucks. Starbucks is renowned for the way it implements unique sensory experiences, and in this way, serves as an exemplary case to understand how the sensory elements such as sight, aroma, music, interior and taste impacts the loyalty and preferences of young customers in Starbucks. Previously documented literature and research was referred as a foundation for this study, while additional opportunities to diversify and expand, the study was identified. The quantitative research approach method was used by drafting a questionnaire on the topic and analyze the extent to which the sensory marketing used by Starbucks actually affect its young customers. To fascinate to study, five point Liker scale was used with questions aligned with the topic. For this purpose 200 questionnaires were distributed for the survey.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定量方法探讨星巴克感官营销对年轻顾客忠诚度和偏好的影响，发现多感官体验显著提升顾客满意度和忠诚度。
AI.research_question: 星巴克的感官营销（视觉、嗅觉、听觉、触觉、味觉）如何影响年轻顾客的忠诚度和偏好？
AI.motivation: 感官营销近年来受到学术界和营销研究者关注，但针对特定品牌（如星巴克）对年轻顾客群体的影响研究相对有限，星巴克作为感官营销的典范案例值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感官营销理论、顾客体验理论、顾客忠诚度理论
AI.method: 定量研究方法，采用问卷调查，使用5点李克特量表，发放200份问卷，分析星巴克感官营销要素对年轻顾客的影响程度
AI.findings: 星巴克的多感官体验（视觉设计、咖啡香气、背景音乐、店内环境、饮品口味）对年轻顾客的忠诚度和偏好产生显著正向影响
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了感官营销理论在特定品牌和年轻消费群体中的应用，提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为星巴克等餐饮企业优化感官营销策略提供实践指导，帮助提升年轻顾客群体的忠诚度和满意度

title: Mental Health and the Early Career Dynamics of Young Men
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School, Washington University, Saint Louis - John M. Olin School of Business , Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School and Washington University in St. Louis - Department of Economics

detail.title: Mental Health and the Early Career Dynamics of Young Men
detail.abstract: Do poor mental and physical health scar early career labor market trajectories? Using longitudinal data from the Household Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia (HILDA), we document the life-cycle patterns and analyze the two-way interactions between health and labor market outcomes. To address health endogeneity, we exploit exogenous life shocks as instruments, identifying the negative short-run effects on health. Building on this evidence, we develop a dynamic discrete choice model with unobserved heterogeneity, allowing for correlation between health and income. Our estimates show that poor health, especially mental health, significantly reduces the likelihood of full-time employment and raises the probability of not working relative to part-time work. A strong scarring effect of mental health shocks emerges, leading to persistently weaker recovery paths and lower earnings. Our counterfactuals highlight three findings: (i) permanent health and income types jointly drive large inequality, with low types earning half as much as high types; (ii) persistent poor mental health contributes to higher earnings inequality than physical health; and (iii) transitory health and labor market shocks have long-run negative effects on labor supply choices, amplified with poor mental health. By jointly modeling the dynamics of mental and physical health, we disentangle their distinct roles, show how health shocks scar individuals over the life-cycle, and highlight the importance of early mental health interventions for sustaining productivity and reducing inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文使用澳大利亚HILDA纵向数据，通过工具变量法和动态离散选择模型，发现心理健康问题对早期职业生涯有显著的疤痕效应，导致就业率下降、收入不平等加剧，并强调早期心理健康干预的重要性。
AI.research_question: 不良的心理和身体健康是否会对早期职业生涯产生疤痕效应？
AI.motivation: 探究健康与劳动力市场结果之间的双向互动关系，特别关注心理健康对职业发展的长期影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态离散选择模型，包含未观察到的异质性，允许健康与收入之间的相关性
AI.method: 使用澳大利亚家庭收入与劳动力动态(HILDA)纵向数据，利用外生生活冲击作为工具变量解决健康内生性问题
AI.findings: 不良健康（特别是心理健康）显著降低全职就业可能性，增加不工作概率；心理健康冲击具有强烈疤痕效应，导致恢复路径更弱和收入更低
AI.theory_contributions: 通过联合建模心理和身体健康动态，揭示它们的不同作用机制，展示健康冲击在整个生命周期中的疤痕效应
AI.practical_contributions: 强调早期心理健康干预对维持生产力和减少不平等的重要性，为政策制定提供实证依据

title: Loyalty and Preference in Sustainable Product Choice
affiliations: University of Hawaii at Manoa - Department of Marketing, Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business and New York University (NYU) - Center for Sustainable Business

detail.title: Loyalty and Preference in Sustainable Product Choice
detail.abstract: Repeat purchase rates critically affect the expected customer lifetime value (CLV). These rates are determined by customer loyalty to the previously purchased product or brand (state dependence) and baseline consumer preferences for that product. In this paper, we examine both components for consumer packaged goods that utilize onpackage sustainability labels in comparison to those without such labels. Examining data in five consumer packaged goods categories for 64,298 households across the US between 2015 to 2021, we find that consumers are loyal not only to brand but also to the specific sustainability labels. Furthermore, households in our sample tend to have lower mean preferences and lower dispersion of preferences for sustainable products, indicating that sustainable products are seen as closer substitutes with each other than non-sustainable products with other non-sustainable products. With similar product margins, this would imply lower CLV for sustainable products. Our results suggest that, although sustainability labels can increase the loyalty to a set of products, they do not serve as a substitute for brand value in generating higher CLV.

AI.tldr: 可持续标签产品虽然能提高消费者忠诚度，但消费者对可持续产品的偏好均值和离散度较低，导致可持续产品被视为更接近的替代品，从而降低了客户终身价值(CLV)。可持续标签不能替代品牌价值来创造更高的CLV。
AI.research_question: 可持续标签如何影响消费者重复购买行为和客户终身价值？与无标签产品相比，可持续标签产品的状态依赖性和基线消费者偏好有何差异？
AI.motivation: 重复购买率对客户终身价值至关重要，而可持续标签在消费品包装上的应用日益普遍，需要了解其对消费者忠诚度和偏好的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户终身价值(CLV)理论、状态依赖性理论、消费者偏好理论、可持续消费行为理论
AI.method: 使用2015-2021年美国64,298个家庭在5个消费品类别的购买数据，分析有/无可持续标签产品的重复购买行为和消费者偏好
AI.findings: 1) 消费者不仅对品牌忠诚，也对特定可持续标签忠诚；2) 可持续产品的消费者偏好均值和离散度较低；3) 可持续产品被视为更接近的替代品；4) 在相似产品利润率下，可持续产品的CLV较低
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了状态依赖性理论在可持续消费领域的应用，揭示了可持续标签对消费者偏好结构和产品替代性的独特影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定可持续产品营销策略提供实证依据，表明单纯依赖可持续标签不足以提升CLV，需要结合品牌价值建设

title: The Heterogeneous Effect of Dropping Out for Higher Education Students: The French Case

detail.title: The Heterogeneous Effect of Dropping Out for Higher Education Students: The French Case
detail.abstract: For higher education systems with general and vocational degrees, the question of resource allocation for dropout policies is fundamental. In France, the university concentrates most of the focus and resources compared to the vocational track. I estimate the heterogeneous effect of dropping out on labor market outcomes (employment rate and wages), conditional on the student’s degree, to evaluate the validity of this allocation. I use a causal Random Forest methodology to account for the heterogeneous cohort composition of these degrees, with the distance to the closest higher education institution as an instrument for dropout. Using 2SLS leads to underestimating the overall effect of dropping out by 9 percentage points for the employment rate and by 4 percentage points for the average wage. Vocational degree dropouts are more penalized than university dropouts on their average wage but not on their time in employment. Finally, using a multidimensional categorization of students can be beneficial for creating a targeted dropout policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了法国高等教育中辍学对劳动力市场结果的异质性影响，发现职业学位辍学者在工资方面比大学辍学者受到更大惩罚，但就业时间无显著差异。使用因果随机森林方法比传统2SLS能更准确估计辍学效应。
AI.research_question: 法国高等教育体系中，辍学对不同学位类型（普通大学学位与职业学位）学生的劳动力市场结果（就业率和工资）是否存在异质性影响？
AI.motivation: 法国高等教育资源分配不均衡，大学获得大部分关注和资源，而职业轨道相对被忽视。需要评估这种资源分配是否合理，通过分析辍学对不同学位类型学生的异质性影响来指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于高等教育辍学与劳动力市场结果关系的理论框架，考虑学位类型的异质性效应和选择偏差问题。
AI.method: 采用因果随机森林方法处理学位类型的异质性队列组成问题，使用距离最近高等教育机构的距离作为辍学的工具变量。
AI.findings: 1) 2SLS方法低估辍学总体效应9个百分点（就业率）和4个百分点（平均工资）；2) 职业学位辍学者在平均工资上比大学辍学者受到更大惩罚，但在就业时间上无显著差异；3) 多维学生分类有助于制定针对性辍学政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了处理高等教育辍学异质性效应的因果推断方法，揭示了学位类型在辍学影响中的调节作用，丰富了教育经济学中关于辍学后果的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法国高等教育资源分配政策提供实证依据，建议重新评估对大学和职业轨道的资源分配，支持制定针对不同学生群体的精准辍学干预政策。

title: Measuring Markups: Revisiting the Cost Accounting Approach

detail.title: Measuring Markups: Revisiting the Cost Accounting Approach
detail.abstract: Among the ways to measure market power, special attention has always been given to the wedge between marginal cost and price: the markup. This paper investigates the validity of firm-level markup estimation techniques, focusing on the cost accounting (CA) approach—a straightforward, transparent, and data-thrifty alternative that, despite its origins in the early industrial organization literature, has seen little modern application. While the production function (PF) approach has quickly become the workhorse method in macroeconomic applications, several high-profile criticisms have brought its validity into question. My findings show that the rise in U.S. markups is robust to CA, suggesting that the trend is not driven by biases. In fact, variation in PF estimates is driven almost entirely by variation in its 'accounting component,' rather than its 'production function component,' which contains the well-known biases. For validation, I develop a novel test based on Dorfman-Steiner's (1954) advertising equation, concluding that the cost accounting approach provides a much higher signal of underlying markups in some cross sections, though both measures offer signal of underlying markups. The data-thrifty nature of CA makes it feasible for a broader range of applications. To highlight this, I conclude with several applications that play into CA's strengths. Collectively, these results suggest that CA should be preferred to PF in some cases, although it can sometimes be useful to try both.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了成本会计法(CA)作为企业层面加价估算方法的有效性，发现美国加价上升趋势对CA方法稳健，且CA在某些情况下比生产函数法(PF)提供更高的信号质量，数据需求更少，应用范围更广。
AI.research_question: 成本会计法(CA)作为企业层面加价估算方法的有效性如何？与生产函数法(PF)相比有何优劣？
AI.motivation: 生产函数法(PF)虽然已成为宏观应用的主流方法，但其有效性受到质疑，而成本会计法(CA)作为一种直接、透明且数据需求少的方法，在现代应用中很少被使用，需要重新评估其价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Dorfman-Steiner(1954)的广告方程理论，构建验证测试框架；工业组织文献中的成本会计理论基础。
AI.method: 采用成本会计法(CA)估算企业层面加价，与生产函数法(PF)进行对比分析，开发基于Dorfman-Steiner方程的新型验证测试。
AI.findings: 1) 美国加价上升趋势对CA方法稳健；2) PF估计的变异几乎完全来自其'会计成分'而非'生产函数成分'；3) CA在某些截面中提供更高的加价信号质量；4) CA数据需求少，应用范围更广。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新验证并确立了成本会计法在加价估算中的理论地位，开发了基于Dorfman-Steiner方程的新型验证方法，为方法论选择提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了数据需求更少的加价估算方法，使更广泛的应用成为可能，为研究者和政策制定者提供了更实用的工具选择指南。

publicationDetails.detailsText: ICTACT Journal on Management Studies, volume 10, issue 4, 2024[10.21917/ijms.2024.0310]

detail.abstract: This study examines customer perceptions and satisfaction with mobile banking services in Maharashtra, India, focusing on how these perceptions vary across different occupational groups. A total of 573 respondents from six districts of Maharashtra (India) participated in an online survey using a 3-point Likert scale. The study investigates several key factors affecting the quality of mobile banking services, including ease of use, scope, speed, privacy, safety, reliability, responsiveness, cost-effectiveness, usefulness, and app appearance. The analysis reveals significant differences in perceptions regarding safety and cost-effectiveness across occupational groups, while other factors such as ease of use and usefulness showed no notable variations. The study contributes to understanding customer satisfaction with mobile banking and provides insights for service providers to improve their offerings, particularly in catering to different user demographics.

title: Cyber Risk in Banking: Measuring and Predicting Vulnerability
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond

detail.title: Cyber Risk in Banking: Measuring and Predicting Vulnerability
detail.abstract: We construct a bank-quarter panel linking external cybersecurity ratings, realized cyber incidents, and regulatory financial data for U.S. banks (2015-2024). Using quarterly rolling-window random forest models with dynamic feature selection, we predict whether a bank will experience a cyber incident within the next year. Both bank characteristics and cybersecurity posture provide independent and complementary predictive content, with the combined model achieving the highest out-of-sample accuracy. Predictive performance remains robust across bank sizes and forecast horizons and is not driven by simple persistence in incident history. Interpretation of the fitted models highlights the consistent importance of size, balance sheet composition, and specific security controls, along with interactions between these controls, in predicting cyber incidents.

title: The Enduring Legacy of Educational Institutions: Evidence from Hyanggyo in Pre-Modern Korea
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University, University of Mannheim and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: The Enduring Legacy of Educational Institutions: Evidence from Hyanggyo in Pre-Modern Korea

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines the long-term impact of Hyanggyo, state-sponsored educational institutions established during the early Joseon Dynasty in Korea (1392-1592), on human capital accumulation. Although these schools largely ceased functioning as educational centers by the late 16th century, their influence has endured to the present day. Drawing on a newly constructed township-level dataset, we find a robust positive association between historical exposure to Hyanggyo and modern educational attainment. This relationship appears to be driven by enduring local demand for education, supported by three complementary findings. First, regions with greater historical exposure experienced larger gains in Japanese literacy during colonial era school expansions. Second, residents in these areas express stronger pro-education attitudes today. Third, historically exposed regions exhibited lower fertility rates, consistent with a quantityquality tradeoff in parental investment. Together, our findings highlight the lasting legacy of early educational institutions.

title: Project Management and New (Social) Media Maturation of a Science and Decline of an Aristocracy
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Project Management and New (Social) Media Maturation of a Science and Decline of an Aristocracy
detail.abstract: Project management has matured through crisis. Each great excitation-from war to oil shocks to globalisation-reshaped its tools and meanings. The field once rested on an aristocracy of lauded managers, their prestige secured by mega projects and retold through case study orthodoxy. Alongside them, academic gurus shaped narratives: Robert McNamara importing RAND's scientism into the World Bank, Albert Hirschman offering the romantic optimism of the Hiding Hand, and, later, Bent Flyvbjerg puncturing both with empirical critique of megaprojects. Today, new media unsettles the balance. No longer can aristocrats hide behind glossy reports or scholars preach unchallenged. Failures, biases, and hidden assumptions are exposed in real time. Contestation has entered the open agora. That contestation is science: conjecture, critique, falsification. In shedding aristocracy and postgraduate ritual, project management is entering a phase of mathematization-a rigorous, adaptive science of projects, forged in openness and complexity.

AI.tldr: 项目管理领域正在经历从传统的精英管理模式向开放、严谨的科学化转型，通过实时争议和证似推动领域成熟。

title: Interviewing With Algorithms: The Role of Non-Functional Attributes in Shaping Algorithmic Evaluation Experience
affiliations: University of Georgia - C. Herman and Mary Virginia Terry College of Business, Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business, Indiana University Bloomington - Kelley School of Business and National Taiwan Normal University

detail.title: Interviewing With Algorithms: The Role of Non-Functional Attributes in Shaping Algorithmic Evaluation Experience
detail.abstract: Algorithmic evaluation is increasingly used across domains such as credit, education, and hiring, raising concerns that opaque and impersonal systems heighten stress for those being assessed. Job interviews, already stressful, exemplify this trend, where, in judging candidates, algorithmic systems affect the very behaviors they measure. In such high-stakes contexts, this can affect their downstream performance which is typically endogenous to interview behavior. Addressing these concerns, however, requires approaches that can improve candidate experience without altering evaluation, which in such contexts is often constrained and less flexible than in others, such as recommendations or personalization. We identify one such lever: non-functional algorithmic attributes, i.e., features such as the gender, appearance, or voice of an AI interviewer, that do not affect decision outcomes but can influence candidate experience. We theorize and test how offering choice over these attributes improves individuals' reactions and performance in algorithmic evaluation. In Study 1, a field experiment within the hiring process of a leading video-interviewing platform, candidates who could choose their AI interviewer's gender performed significantly better. In Study 2, a controlled online experiment, we replicated this effect and examined its mechanisms. Drawing on procedural justice theory, we distinguished between an instrumental pathway (choice evoking perceived control) and a non-instrumental pathway (choice alleviating fairness concerns). Our findings reveal that the effect arises not from perceived control but from heightened fairness perceptions, which reduced anxiety and enabled stronger performance. Robustness checks ruled out alternative explanations, including concerns for superficial performance gains, gender effects, and social desirability bias. Overall, this research contributes to work on algorithm evaluation, equity, and procedural justice by showing how algorithmic evaluation may introduce flexibility of offering symbolic, outcome-indifferent choices in traditionally rigid processes, thereby enhancing fairness perceptions and candidate outcomes. Such choice is a scalable and legally tractable design lever for reducing anxiety and improving experiences in high-stakes algorithmic evaluation.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，在算法评估中提供非功能性属性选择（如AI面试官的性别）能显著提升候选人表现，这种效果主要通过增强公平感而非控制感来实现，为高风险的算法评估提供了可扩展的设计方案。

detail.abstract: This paper explores the transformation of artificial intelligence from a computational tool into a governing infrastructure. Through a realistic scenario projected for the year 2080, it analyzes how algorithmic systems reshape human identity, behavior, and agency. The paper argues that this transformation is not dystopian fiction but a logical extension of current socio-technical trajectories. It proposes a framework for understanding algorithmic authority, digital identity commodification, and epistemic resistance, urging a redefinition of ethical AI beyond performance metrics.

title: Why Perspective Matters in Health Technology Assessment: A New Zealand Case Study of HPV Vaccination, Smoking Cessation Programmes, and Hepatitis C Therapy
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka

detail.title: Why Perspective Matters in Health Technology Assessment: A New Zealand Case Study of HPV Vaccination, Smoking Cessation Programmes, and Hepatitis C Therapy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has previously advised both Australian and New Zealand Health Technology Assessment agencies.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work is based on published simulation models and parameters, and as such did not use data from human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was unfunded.

detail.abstract:
Background
Health technology assessment (HTA) in New Zealand commonly adopts a health-system perspective, which can undervalue interventions with wider societal impacts.

Methods
We built cohort Markov models for HPV vaccination, smoking cessation programs, and hepatitis C antiviral therapy. Lifetime horizons (annual cycles), 3% discounting, and a $50,000/QALY willingness-to-pay (WTP) threshold were used. We compared health-system and societal perspectives (productivity, out-of-pocket, and informal care), conducted probabilistic sensitivity analysis (10,000 iterations) and estimated EVPI/EVPPI.

Results
From the health-system perspective, ICERs were cost-saving (dominant) for HPV vaccination, $1.80/QALY for smoking cessation, and $14,657/QALY for hepatitis C therapy. From the societal perspective, HPV vaccination and smoking cessation became more favourable (dominant and cost-saving, respectively), while hepatitis C remained cost-effective with a higher ICER ($26,435/QALY). Productivity effects were the largest societal component. Societal net monetary benefit (NMB) rose by $73m for HPV and $43m for smoking cessation; for hepatitis C it decreased by $12m due to high upfront treatment costs. Decisions were concordant across perspectives at NZ$50,000/QALY.

Conclusions
Incorporating a societal perspective materially increases estimated value for preventive and behavioural interventions in Aotearoa New Zealand. Curative, high-cost therapies may remain cost-effective but show smaller societal gains. HTA processes that transparently include societal costs and benefits could support more balanced and equitable resource allocation.

AI.tldr: 新西兰卫生技术评估采用卫生系统视角会低估具有更广泛社会影响的干预措施。研究通过马尔可夫模型比较三种干预措施（HPV疫苗接种、戒烟项目、丙肝治疗）在卫生系统视角和社会视角下的成本效益，发现社会视角能更全面评估预防性和行为干预的价值。
AI.research_question: 从社会视角进行卫生技术评估是否会比传统的卫生系统视角更准确地反映干预措施的价值？
AI.motivation: 新西兰现行的卫生技术评估主要采用卫生系统视角，这种视角可能会低估那些具有更广泛社会影响的干预措施的真实价值，特别是预防性和行为干预项目。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于卫生经济学中的成本效益分析框架，采用社会视角评估方法，考虑生产力损失、自付费用和非正式护理等社会成本。
AI.method: 建立队列马尔可夫模型，分析HPV疫苗接种、戒烟项目和丙肝抗病毒治疗三种干预措施。采用终身时间跨度、3%贴现率和5万纽币/QALY的支付意愿阈值，比较卫生系统视角和社会视角的成本效益。
AI.findings: 从卫生系统视角看，三种干预都具有成本效益；从社会视角看，HPV疫苗接种和戒烟项目变得更加有利（分别成为主导和成本节约），丙肝治疗虽然仍具成本效益但ICER升高。生产力效应是最大的社会组成部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了社会视角在卫生技术评估中的重要性，证明了传统卫生系统视角确实会低估预防性和行为干预的社会价值，为HTA方法学提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新西兰卫生政策制定者提供了实证依据，建议在HTA过程中透明地纳入社会成本和收益，以实现更平衡和公平的资源分配决策。

detail.abstract: This paper introduces AIIRSSALT™, a sovereign artificial intelligence framework for real-time taxation, compliance, and revenue assurance. By embedding anomaly detection, blockchain-anchored verification, and sovereignty-by design principles, AIIRSSALT™ redefines the way governments collect taxes, reduce leakage, and strengthen fiscal trust. The framework aligns with global best practices while ensuring that nations retain full control over their data and policy enforcement.

title: Structural Variable Relationship Modeling in Cutting-Edge AI: A Framework Based on Spectra, Topology, and Entropy

detail.title: Structural Variable Relationship Modeling in Cutting-Edge AI: A Framework Based on Spectra, Topology, and Entropy

keywords: Graph Theory and Topological Data Analysis
Causal Path and Signal Variable Modelling

detail.abstract: This study aims to overcome the structural and interpretative limitations encountered in artificial intelligence causal modelling and explainable AI (XAI) when employing advanced topic modelling techniques (LDA/HDP) alongside traditional grounded theory (GT). It proposes a novel structural variablerelationship modelling framework tailored for complex systems. Employing the Structured Variable-Relationship Modelling (SVRM) methodology, this work integrates the Semantic-Structural Variable Modelling with Policy and Power Analysis (SSVM-PPA) framework. It further incorporates cutting-edge mathematical tools including spectral graph theory, topological data analysis, and information entropy analysis. This comprehensive approach enables an end-to-end modelling system spanning semantic text extraction, causal path modelling, AI graph structure construction, and simulation prediction. Systematic evaluation across 30 texts demonstrates SVRM's superiority over LDA and GT in key metrics: average variable extraction (31.07), structural relationship count (40.13), path significance (0.9), and consistency (0.93), showcasing efficiency, stability, and structural completeness. The research concludes that SVRM not only effectively constructs multi-layered, causally directed variable systems but also broadly adapts to Graph Neural Networks (GNN), Bayesian Networks (BN), and Transformer architectures. This enables embeddable, inferable, and interpretable AI modelling pathways, representing a structural and algorithmic breakthrough in post-empiricism knowledge construction. It provides robust support for strategic simulation, policy intervention, and cognitive modelling.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了SVRM框架，结合语义结构变量建模与先进数学工具，解决了AI因果建模和可解释AI在主题建模与扎根理论应用中的局限性，在变量提取、结构关系、路径显著性和一致性方面优于传统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何克服人工智能因果建模和可解释AI在使用高级主题建模技术（LDA/HDP）和传统扎根理论（GT）时遇到的结构性和解释性限制？
AI.motivation: 现有AI因果建模方法在复杂系统中存在结构性和解释性不足的问题，需要开发新的建模框架来提高建模效率和解释能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化变量关系建模（SVRM）方法论，整合语义-结构变量建模与政策权力分析（SSVM-PPA）框架，结合谱图理论、拓扑数据分析和信息熵分析等数学工具。
AI.method: 采用SVRM方法，进行端到端建模系统，包括语义文本提取、因果路径建模、AI图结构构建和模拟预测，在30个文本上进行系统性评估。
AI.findings: SVRM在关键指标上优于LDA和GT：平均变量提取（31.07）、结构关系数量（40.13）、路径显著性（0.9）和一致性（0.93），展现出效率、稳定性和结构完整性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为后经验主义知识构建提供了结构和算法突破，构建了多层因果导向变量系统，可广泛适应GNN、BN和Transformer架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可嵌入、可推断和可解释的AI建模路径，为战略模拟、政策干预和认知建模提供强大支持。

title: Stable and Profitable Trading Platforms for Smallholder Commodity Supply Chains
affiliations: Stanford University - Institute for Computational and Mathematical Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Management Science (MS) and Stanford Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Stable and Profitable Trading Platforms for Smallholder Commodity Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Digital platforms that connect smallholder farmers with intermediaries offer a promising path to first-mile traceability and improved livelihoods. Yet such platforms face several challenges. Full disintermediation is often impossible because intermediaries are essential for logistics and deeply embedded in local informal relationship networks; stability is fragile, as farmers and intermediaries may revert to trading through local informal networks if they derive insufficient value on the platform; profit margins are tight; and operations are complex due to fragmentation, scale, heterogeneity, and significant uncertainty about local informal networks. To address these challenges, we develop a flexible model of the platform's joint decisions-matching farmers to intermediaries and setting payments-that captures potential off-platform deviations via local informal networks and enforces stability constraints that preclude them. Deviations are modeled with ambiguity sets that capture the platform's imperfect information and the breadth of intermediaries' relationship networks. We prove structural results and, leveraging them, design exact and approximate branch-and-bound algorithms. We pair a case study based on real data from Indonesia's palm-oil supply chain with a stylized version of the model that we solve analytically, to derive insights regarding the platform's main decisions. Our findings yield several managerial implications. Profitability depends critically on reducing transportation costs and obtaining at least partial data on informal local networks. Payments should be directed primarily to farmers; surprisingly, if intermediaries have larger relationship networks, platforms should increase payments to farmers and decrease payments to intermediaries, which is the most cost-effective way to ensure stability. In dealing with heterogeneous intermediaries, platforms should use efficient (i.e., minimum-cost) matchings unless some intermediaries have extremely large informal relationship networks, in which case they must be prioritized to ensure stability, despite a loss in efficiency.

This study examines the role of digital taxation in supporting post-conflict economic reconstruction, with a specific application to Syria. The research applies a comparative analysis of five international case studies—Estonia, Mexico, Italy, Turkey, and Germany—focusing on the strengths, weaknesses, and lessons of their digital tax systems. Using a SWOT framework and secondary data from OECD, IMF, World Bank, and UNDP, the paper highlights how digital-first approaches can improve compliance, transparency, and institutional trust.

The findings suggest that fragile and post-conflict states can significantly reduce reconstruction costs and accelerate recovery by adopting phased digital tax reforms, such as e-filing, e-invoicing, AI-based audits, and blockchain transparency tools. The Syrian case study demonstrates that a hybrid model—combining Estonia’s efficiency, Germany’s institutional resilience, and Turkey’s gradual implementation—offers the most suitable framework for sustainable reform.

The paper concludes that digital taxation is not only a fiscal necessity but also a tool for rebuilding governance and trust in fragile contexts. detail.abstract: This research aims to explore the electrocution risks in Bangladesh and analyze its causes, consequences, and the relevant existing laws. Although there has been a growth in electrical infrastructure, electrocution remains a major public health risk causing numerous injuries, fatalities and enormous socio-economic consequences. It explores the historical evolution and changes in the legal systems related to the Electricity Act, 2018, and the Electricity Rules, 2019 pointing out their lack of adequate provisions for preventing wrongs. There are also lack of compensation and liability mechanisms. It compares these regulations with the best practices stating that compensation should be strong, the measures required in investigations should be clearly outlined and that negligence should attract stringent sanctions. The recommendations include compensation for the victims, specific guidelines for conducting investigations and implementation of strict standards in safety. To strengthen the legal shield for those involved in this process and prevent future occurrences, it is crucial to address these concerns. The aim of this research is to contribute to the discourses on electrical safety and legal advancement in Bangladesh to establish a more secure flow of electricity.

title:
A Critical Analysis of Republic Act No. 9003 
Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
A Critical Analysis of Republic Act No. 9003 
Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
detail.abstract:
This critique looks at the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000 (Republic Act No. 9003). This law was created in response to the tragic Payatas landslide. As a student studying Environmental Waste Management in the Philippines, I examine how RA 9003 presents a good and complete framework. It includes institutions, local governance, community engagement, and environmental health in its design. However, based on audit reports and case studies, I argue that the law's real-world impact falls short. There are gaps in local implementation, uneven infrastructure, such as Material Recovery Facilities and sanitary landfills, and weak enforcement and public awareness. 

By looking at successful examples, like Cebu City, this paper shows that meeting RA 9003's goals needs political will, proper funding, coordination, and skill-building at the local level. I end with specific, student-informed policy recommendations. These include flexible use of funds for staffing, stronger public education, and integrating informal waste collectors. These steps can help turn the law's promise into cleaner streets and a more sustainable future for Filipino communities.

declarations.funderStatement: No funder

detail.abstract: This brief discusses five critical dynamics that are often viewed separately: (1) rapid automation in China; (2) tariff incidence and trade diversion; (3) U.S. skills mismatches; (4) population-scale mental health treatment; and (5) mass incarceration. Using robotics statistics, research on tariff incidence, labor market data, and estimates of the prison population, tariffs mainly act as a tax on U.S. consumption and do little to rebuild broad- based, labor-intensive manufacturing. China’s already robot-rich production reduces the labor share of costs, weakening the impact of tariffs. Additionally, supply chains often shift through third countries instead of returning directly to the U.S. Domestically, the The strongest demand is for middle-skill technical roles (such as industrial maintenance, electrical work, and linework), alongside the ongoing demand for software and engineering—meaning that ‘education’ should be understood as skills and credentials, not necessarily four-year degrees. Lastly, U.S. incarceration and community supervision remain high by global standards; credible evidence shows that postsecondary education Structured reentry programs help lower recidivism. The best policy approach to boost welfare and competitiveness is a skills-first, outcomes-focused strategy combined with evidence-based behavioral health and reentry services, rather than relying solely on tariffs.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了五个关键动态：中国快速自动化、关税影响与贸易转移、美国技能错配、大规模心理健康治疗和监禁问题。研究发现关税主要作为美国消费税，对重建劳动密集型制造业作用有限；中国自动化生产削弱关税影响；供应链通过第三国转移而非直接回流美国；美国需要中技能技术人才而非仅四年制学位；监禁率居高不下，教育再入项目可降低再犯率。最佳政策是技能优先、结果导向策略结合行为健康服务，而非仅依赖关税。
AI.research_question: 关税政策在重建美国劳动密集型制造业和提高竞争力方面的有效性如何？以及什么才是提升福利和竞争力的最佳政策方法？
AI.motivation: 当前政策讨论往往将自动化、关税、技能错配、心理健康和监禁等问题分开看待，需要综合理解这些动态如何相互作用，以及关税政策在实际效果上的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际贸易理论（关税 incidence 理论）、劳动力市场理论（技能错配理论）、犯罪学理论（再犯率与教育关系）以及产业自动化理论的多学科分析框架。
AI.method: 使用机器人统计数据、关税影响研究、劳动力市场数据以及监狱人口估计进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 1) 关税主要作为美国消费税，对重建劳动密集型制造业作用有限；2) 中国自动化生产降低劳动力成本占比，削弱关税影响；3) 供应链通过第三国转移而非直接回流美国；4) 美国最需要中技能技术人才；5) 教育再入项目能有效降低再犯率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了多维度动态相互作用的综合分析框架，挑战了单一关税政策的有效性假设，强调了技能优先和证据为基础的政策方法的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的建议：采用技能优先、结果导向的策略，结合行为健康和再入服务，而非单纯依赖关税政策来提升国家竞争力和福利水平。

title: Children as Informal Pensions: Intergenerational Insurance and Policy Risks in Africa
affiliations: SBS Swiss Business School

detail.title: Children as Informal Pensions: Intergenerational Insurance and Policy Risks in Africa
detail.abstract: In many African societies, children function as informal pensions, providing financial and caregiving support where formal social protection remains weak or nonexistent. This system, rooted in kinship and cultural ethics such as Ubuntu, has been understood both as an intergenerational investment and as a moral duty. However, demographic transition, youth unemployment, and fragile pension systems threaten its sustainability. While research has focused on fertility decline, dependency ratios, and remittance flows, the ethical and psychosocial dimensions remain underexplored. This paper introduces the Filial Insurance Model (FIM), which synthesizes three logics: investment (parental anticipation of reciprocity), obligation (cultural and moral duty), and sustainability (children's actual capacity to provide). It further develops the concept of the intergenerational insurance trap, where parental expectations collide with children's constrained resources, producing cycles of unmet obligations, relational strain, and poverty transfer. The contribution is threefold: reframing intergenerational support as both economic and ethical; providing a testable framework for future empirical research; and advancing de-risking strategies through hybrid approaches that integrate formal pensions with culturally rooted reciprocity. In doing so, the paper highlights the fragility of reliance on children for old-age security and underscores the urgency of policies that balance cultural traditions with sustainable protections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了孝顺保险模型(FIM)，分析非洲社会中子女作为非正式养老金的伦理与心理维度，揭示了代际保险陷阱问题，并提出了整合正式养老金与文化互惠的混合解决方案。
AI.research_question: 在非洲社会中，子女作为非正式养老金的伦理和心理维度如何影响代际支持的可持续性？
AI.motivation: 非洲社会依赖子女养老的传统模式面临人口转型、青年失业和脆弱养老金系统的威胁，但现有研究主要关注生育率下降和汇款流动，缺乏对伦理和心理维度的深入探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 孝顺保险模型(FIM)，整合三种逻辑：投资逻辑（父母对互惠的预期）、义务逻辑（文化和道德责任）、可持续性逻辑（子女实际供养能力）。
AI.method: 理论框架构建和概念发展，提出代际保险陷阱概念。
AI.findings: 揭示了代际保险陷阱现象，即父母期望与子女有限资源之间的冲突导致义务未履行、关系紧张和贫困传递的循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新构建代际支持为经济与伦理的双重框架；为未来实证研究提供可测试的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出通过整合正式养老金与文化互惠的混合方法推进去风险策略，强调平衡文化传统与可持续保护的政策紧迫性。

title: Enduring Impact, Institutional Resilience and Future Trajectories of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights
affiliations: Institute of the Americas, University College London and University College London

detail.title: Enduring Impact, Institutional Resilience and Future Trajectories of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights
detail.abstract:
This chapter aims to highlight the vital and distinctive role that the IACtHR plays in regional human rights governance, demonstrating its capacity to foster change even under inhospitable political conditions. However, both the Court and the broader Inter-American Human Rights System (IAHRS) face a complex array of challenges; some structural and long-standing, such as concerns over legitimacy, effectiveness, and institutional capacity, and others more immediate, driven by democratic erosion, authoritarian resurgence, and increasing restrictions on civil society. These issues are deeply interconnected, forming a web of pressures that make this a critical moment for the Court’s future relevance. Over more than four decades, the IACtHR has evolved into a fully functioning international tribunal, adjudicating cases, facilitating reparations, and shaping human rights norms. Yet, this progress has been accompanied by persistent obstacles, including chronic underfunding and political backlash, with some governments threatening as well as executing withdrawal in response to adverse rulings. Paradoxically, such tensions underscore both the Court’s enduring significance and the fragility of its mandate in today’s volatile geopolitical climate. Despite its imperfections, the IACtHR remains a crucial mechanism for holding states accountable and empowering individuals and communities to challenge entrenched power structures. The central question is not whether the Court – and human rights more generally – have a future, but how they must evolve to remain effective in a rapidly changing world.

The chapter is structured in three parts. The first part examines the notion of impact beyond compliance, showing how the IACtHR shapes human rights not only through state adherence to rulings but also via its institutional evolution and five key functions that shape regional human rights governance. The second part addresses the complex challenges currently facing the Court, including long-standing structural issues and more immediate political threats, while also identifying sources of resilience that sustain its role. The third and final part looks ahead, outlining three possible future trajectories for the Court – progressive renewal, institutional decline, and a more likely scenario of “muddling through” – and explores how the IACtHR might adapt, innovate, and reaffirm its relevance in an increasingly fraught regional and global context.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨美洲人权法院在区域人权治理中的关键作用，分析其面临的长期结构性挑战和当前政治威胁，并展望三种未来发展方向：渐进革新、制度衰退或维持现状的'应付前行'。
AI.research_question: 美洲人权法院如何在快速变化的世界中保持有效性并继续发展？
AI.motivation: 美洲人权法院和整个美洲人权体系面临复杂的挑战，包括合法性、有效性、制度能力等长期结构性问题，以及民主侵蚀、威权主义复兴等即时政治威胁，这些因素相互关联，构成了对法院未来相关性的关键考验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 超越合规的影响概念，强调法院不仅通过国家遵守裁决，还通过制度演变和五项关键功能来塑造区域人权治理。
AI.method: 文献分析和制度分析，分为三个部分：第一部分分析法院的影响机制，第二部分评估当前挑战和韧性来源，第三部分展望未来可能的发展轨迹。
AI.findings: 美洲人权法院在40多年间已发展成为功能完备的国际法庭，但面临资金不足、政治反弹等持续障碍；法院通过裁决案件、促进赔偿和塑造人权规范发挥着重要作用；当前面临结构性问题和政治威胁的双重压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了'超越合规的影响'理论框架，强调国际人权法院通过多种机制产生影响的复杂性；提供了分析国际法院韧性和适应能力的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美洲人权法院的未来发展提供了三种可能路径的分析；为国际人权机构在政治压力下的生存和发展策略提供了实践参考；强调了法院在追究国家责任和赋权个人方面的重要作用。

title: Geometric Necessity: Resolving the Ellipse Perimeter Problem with Discrete Lattice Computation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Geometric Necessity: Resolving the Ellipse Perimeter Problem with Discrete Lattice Computation
detail.abstract: The ellipse perimeter problem, unsolved for over 300 years due to the absence of an elementary closed-form expression, is resolved through a novel discrete computational method rooted in the Tetrahedral-Octahedral (TH-OH) lattice geometry. This paper presents a Python implementation that computes the perimeter of an ellipse (A=1.5, B=1.0) as 7.944032 units using a constructible constant , outperforming traditional approximations like Ramanujan's 7.932 units. By rejecting unconstructible transcendental constants (e.g.,) and infinite series, this approach demonstrates that discrete, finite geometry supersedes continuous models, shattering the foundation of classical computational geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基于四面体-八面体(TH-OH)晶格几何的新型离散计算方法，解决了300多年来因缺乏初等闭式表达式而悬而未决的椭圆周长问题。Python实现显示该方法计算椭圆周长(A=1.5, B=1.0)为7.944032单位，优于拉马努金近似值7.932单位。
AI.research_question: 如何通过离散计算方法解决椭圆周长问题，避免使用不可构造的超越常数和无穷级数？
AI.motivation: 椭圆周长问题300多年来一直缺乏初等闭式表达式，传统方法依赖超越常数和无穷级数，需要寻找基于离散几何的替代解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四面体-八面体(TH-OH)晶格几何理论，离散计算几何，拒绝不可构造的超越常数和无穷级数。
AI.method: 基于TH-OH晶格几何的离散计算方法，使用Python实现具体计算过程。
AI.findings: 计算得到椭圆(A=1.5, B=1.0)周长为7.944032单位，优于拉马努金近似值7.932单位，证明了离散有限几何方法的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 颠覆了经典计算几何的连续模型基础，证明离散有限几何方法可以超越传统连续模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了计算椭圆周长的新方法，避免了传统方法中的不可构造常数和无穷级数，具有更好的计算性能。

title: Military Virtues, Green Human Resource Management and Green Employee Engagement: An Echo from Sri Lanka Navy
affiliations: University of Sri Jayewardenepura, , Wayamba University of Sri Lanka, Romanian Academy - Romanian Academy, National University of Political Studies and Public Administration (NSPSPA) - Faculty of Public Administration, Universitas Mercatorum and University of Sri Jayewardenepura, Sri Lanka

detail.title: Military Virtues, Green Human Resource Management and Green Employee Engagement: An Echo from Sri Lanka Navy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that there is no conflict of interest!
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare that there are no ethical issues!
declarations.funderStatement: I declare that there are no funds for this research!

detail.abstract: This study aims to identify the mediating effect of green human resource management on the relationship between military virtues and green employee engagement. The sample size is 200 from the Sri Lanka Navy officers. This is a quantitative study. The unit of analysis is individual, and this cross-sectional study was completed in a non-contrived setting with minimal interference by the researcher. This study employs a partial least squares (PLS) regression model within the Smart PLS 4.0 software framework to investigate the underlying objectives. The primary focus entails a meticulous examination of the measurement model, ensuring the robustness of the questionnaire through a thorough assessment of reliability and validity. Subsequently, the study delves into a structural model, uncovering a significant partial mediation effect attributed to green human resource management in the interplay between military virtues and green employee engagement. The implications of these findings are twofold, valuable contributions to both theoretical understanding and practical applications in the domain of sustainable human resource practices. By elucidating the intricate relationships among these constructs, this research enriches the existing knowledge base and provides actionable insights for organizations seeking to foster environmentally conscious employee engagement.

title: AI Actionability Over Interpretability

detail.title: AI Actionability Over Interpretability
detail.abstract: Traditional approaches to model risk management emphasize interpretability--understanding how models generate outputs--as a foundation for trust and governance. This paper argues that interpretability, while valuable, is insufficient for effective risk management of generative AI systems. Unlike conventional models that can be decomposed into discrete, understandable components, large language models exhibit emergent behavior arising from complex parameter interactions. Moreover, enterprise AI deployments increasingly involve multiple systems including retrieval-augmented generation, guardrails, and agents that further complicate interpretability efforts. We propose prioritizing actionability over interpretability--ensuring that AI reasoning processes are sufficiently observable to enable timely diagnosis and remediation when failures occur. This approach includes techniques such as Chain-of-Thought reasoning, Chain-of-Prompts scaffolding, and agentic tracing to create structured observability into AI decision-making processes. While these methods currently face limitations and vulnerabilities, they provide a more practical foundation for building trust in AI systems than interpretability alone. Actionability through observability offers financial institutions and regulators a viable path for responsible AI deployment at scale, potentially warranting updates to existing model risk management frameworks, such as SR 11-7.

AI.tldr: 论文主张在生成式AI系统的风险管理中，行动性比可解释性更重要，提出通过可观测性技术来确保AI推理过程能够被及时诊断和修复。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI系统的风险管理中，可解释性是否足够？如果不是，什么方法能更有效地管理风险？
AI.motivation: 传统模型风险管理强调可解释性，但生成式AI系统（如大语言模型）具有涌现行为和复杂参数交互，企业AI部署涉及多个系统组件，使得可解释性方法不足以有效管理风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于模型风险管理和AI系统可观测性理论，挑战传统可解释性优先的范式。
AI.method: 提出优先考虑行动性而非可解释性的方法，包括思维链推理、提示链框架和智能体追踪等技术来创建结构化可观测性。
AI.findings: 可解释性虽然有价值，但对于生成式AI系统的有效风险管理是不够的；行动性通过可观测性提供了更实用的信任建立基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统模型风险管理中可解释性优先的范式，提出了行动性优先的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构和监管机构提供了负责任AI规模化部署的可行路径，建议更新现有模型风险管理框架（如SR 11-7）。

title: Deglobalisation or Reglobalisation? A Macroperspective on the Reemergence of the Global Economy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Deglobalisation or Reglobalisation? A Macroperspective on the Reemergence of the Global Economy
detail.abstract: Recent geopolitical and economic shocks, such as the rise of protectionist trade policies, Brexit, and the Russia-Ukraine conflict, have shaken the foundation of globalisation. While often invisible, some borders have become more porous, while others have become less so. The deglobalisation hypothesis is gaining traction in response to these shocks. This paper attempts to debunk this hypothesis by proposing a counterbalancing reglobalisation hypothesis. Rather than representing a decline in globalisation, the global economy is transforming towards a more strategically realigned system. Through an analysis of trends in trade flows, foreign direct investment, and migration, this paper argues that the global economy is undergoing a structural adjustment, marked by increasing regionalisation and technological advancement. The paper identifies a shift in the global economic order and a transfer of political power from the West to the East driven by political realignment, relocation of trade and investment, restrategising, and remigration. It concludes that reglobalisation offers a more comprehensive framework for understanding regional transformations and their role in shaping the future of globalisation. Recommendations for future research are offered.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析贸易流、外国直接投资和移民趋势，提出再全球化假说来反驳去全球化观点，认为全球经济正在向更具战略调整的系统转型，表现为区域化加强和技术进步。
AI.research_question: 全球地缘政治和经济冲击是否导致去全球化，还是正在发生向再全球化的结构性调整？
AI.motivation: 近期保护主义贸易政策、英国脱欧和俄乌冲突等地缘政治经济冲击动摇了全球化基础，去全球化假说日益流行，但需要检验其有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球化理论、地缘政治经济学、区域化理论
AI.method: 通过分析贸易流量、外国直接投资和移民趋势的数据进行趋势分析
AI.findings: 全球经济正在进行结构性调整，表现为区域化加强和技术进步，政治权力从西方向东方转移，通过政治重新调整、贸易投资重新布局、战略重新制定和移民重新配置实现
AI.theory_contributions: 提出再全球化假说作为理解全球化转型的新框架，挑战传统的去全球化观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解全球经济转型的视角，帮助企业适应区域化趋势，为未来研究提供方向建议

title: Beyond Duality: Exploring "Nothingness" in the Advaita Vedānta and the Madhyamaka Traditions of Indian Buddhism
affiliations: Al Seeb Vocational College Muscat Oman

detail.title: Beyond Duality: Exploring "Nothingness" in the Advaita Vedānta and the Madhyamaka Traditions of Indian Buddhism
detail.abstract: This article explores the concept of "nothingness" in the Advaita Vedānta and Madhyamaka traditions of Indian Buddhism, analysing their convergences, divergences, and broader implications within Indian philosophical traditions. Both systems emphasize the transcendence of duality and the limitations of ordinary perception in realizing ultimate truth. For Advaita Vedānta, Brahman-the singular, eternal essence-is the sole reality, with the phenomenal world regarded as an illusion (māyā). Liberation arises through self-realization, where one recognizes the unity of self (atman) and Brahman. Conversely, Madhyamaka Buddhism denies the existence of any inherent essence, positing emptiness (Śūnyatā) as the nature of all phenomena. Liberation in this framework involves the cessation of clinging and the realization of interdependence. The article contextualizes these philosophies within their socio-cultural milieus, revealing how their metaphysical claims respond to existential and ethical concerns. While Advaita seeks to unify diversity through non-dualism, Madhyamaka challenges rigid constructs, emphasizing relational existence. Comparative analysis highlights shared principles, such as the critique of egobased delusion and the transformative power of wisdom, alongside distinct soteriological paths rooted in their metaphysical differences. By engaging with these traditions, the article not only underscores their philosophical richness, but also explores their relevance to contemporary issues, including existential anxiety and ethical dilemmas.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the efficacy of post-merger integration (PMI) strategies in enhancing the operational and financial performance of private equity (PE)-backed companies in South Korea. Utilizing a mixed-methods approach that combines quantitative regression analysis of financial data with qualitative thematic analysis of executive interviews, this research identifies the critical drivers of postacquisition success. The findings reveal that structured PMI strategies focusing on leadership alignment, cultural integration, and technological innovation are pivotal for achieving significant growth in operating profits. Notably, regression analysis indicates that technological integration has the most substantial positive impact on profitability (β = 0.405, p < 0.001). Key qualitative insights emphasize the necessity of a cohesive strategic vision, transparent communication to mitigate cultural resistance, and the leveraging of advanced technologies like AI to streamline operations. This paper contributes to the literature by bridging theoretical frameworks-such as the Resource-Based View (RBV) and Dynamic Capability Theory-with practical application. It culminates in a proposed PMI framework tailored for the unique economic and cultural context of South Korean firms, offering actionable recommendations for PE practitioners, corporate leaders, and policymakers to maximize long-term value creation.

declarations.funderStatement: I, Monoshre Chakma, am the sole author of this research paper titled “The Role of Tourism in the Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT) Economy: Opportunities and Challenges.” This work was conducted independently as part of my undergraduate studies at Lalmatia Government Mohila College, Department of Science. All research, writing, and analysis presented in this paper are my own work.

detail.abstract: Tourism has emerged as a growing sector in Bangladesh, with the Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT) offering unique opportunities for eco-tourism, cultural tourism, and adventure travel. This paper explores the contribution of tourism to the CHT economy, highlighting both its potential and its limitations. Using secondary data from government reports, NGO studies, and academic research, the study examines how tourism generates income, creates jobs, and promotes indigenous crafts, while also identifying barriers such as poor infrastructure, political instability, and environmental degradation. Findings suggest that sustainable and community-based tourism can play a significant role in improving livelihoods and preserving cultural heritage. However, without proper policy frameworks and inclusive planning, tourism risks marginalizing indigenous communities and harming the ecological balance. The paper concludes by recommending strategies for sustainable tourism development in the CHT to ensure long-term economic and social benefits.

title: Pricing Strategies in Online Education
affiliations: , University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management and University of Minnesota - Minneapolis

detail.title: Pricing Strategies in Online Education
detail.abstract: What is the optimal pricing strategy in an online education context? In this paper, we propose three pricing strategies for online education: single upfront pricing, upfront pricing combined with a certification fee, and upfront pricing combined with cashback. We develop a game-theoretical framework to explore the impact of these pricing strategies on user learning and purchasing behaviors, and we discuss which is optimal under different circumstances. Within this framework, we capture the unique characteristics of online education products and online learners by considering cost uncertainty and users' present-biased preferences. Our findings suggest that the cashback strategy is optimal when the market anticipates that the required effort cost will be high relative to the benefits earned, whereas the certification strategy is optimal when the market expects the effort cost to be low relative to the benefits gained.

title: The Cost of Inaccessibility: Retail Discrimination and Mobility-Constrained Consumers
affiliations: Texas Tech University and

detail.title: The Cost of Inaccessibility: Retail Discrimination and Mobility-Constrained Consumers
detail.abstract: This study investigates whether individuals with mobility-related health conditions face systematic disadvantages in retail pricing, both in physical stores and on online platforms. While price discrimination is a common feature of modern markets, limited attention has been paid to how physical mobility constraints may affect consumers' ability to access lower prices or respond to promotions. Using matched observational data from the NielsenIQ and the Open E-Commerce dataset, we compare purchasing behavior and price outcomes between consumers with and without mobility-related health conditions. We find that mobility-constrained individuals pay modestly higher prices in physical stores and face even larger price disparities in online purchases, particularly among wheelchair users. Our findings highlight mobility as an underexamined axis of vulnerability in consumer markets. The results have implications for the design of retail pricing systems and digital platforms, as well as for policy efforts aimed at improving equity in access to essential goods.

title: Shock Doctrine in the Life Sciences - When Fear Overwhelms Facts

detail.title: Shock Doctrine in the Life Sciences - When Fear Overwhelms Facts
detail.abstract: Emerging biotechnologies have repeatedly triggered public alarms that exceed empirical evidence of risk. From recombinant DNA and genetically modified crops to synthetic cells, AI-enabled drug design, and the speculative creation of “mirror life,” the life sciences have cycled through periods of dramatic warnings followed by measured scientific progress. This essay examines how worst-case narratives—what Naomi Klein termed the “Shock Doctrine”—have shaped governance by privileging hypothetical catastrophes over demonstrated benefits. Historical case studies and contemporary debates illustrate how fear-driven policy can suppress innovation, distort public trust, and impose ethical costs as serious as the risks it seeks to avoid. Recombinant DNA research produced insulin rather than pandemics, and genetically modified crops improved yields without the ecological collapses that were forecast. Current claims that AI or mirror life inevitably pose existential threats risk repeating this cycle. A proportional, evidence-based approach to biotechnology risk assessment is recommended—one that safeguards against genuine hazards while avoiding speculative extremes. Such a framework can sustain both innovation and safety, resisting the paralysis that results when fear overwhelms fact.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了生物技术发展中的过度恐慌现象，指出历史上从重组DNA到转基因作物等多项技术都被过度担忧，但实际风险远小于预测。文章建议采用基于证据的比例风险评估框架，在保障安全的同时避免抑制创新。

title: Polyphenols, minerals and fatty acids present in Chia seed (Salvia hispanica L.) produced in different regions of South America

detail.title: Polyphenols, minerals and fatty acids present in Chia seed (Salvia hispanica L.) produced in different regions of South America
detail.abstract: This research has been undertaken to explore the proximal composition, polyphenols, mineral contents, and fatty acid composition in chia seed cultivated in Chile, Bolivia, and different sites in Paraguay and Argentina. Crude protein, ash, and dietary fiber contents are higher in two sites in Argentina compared to one site in Paraguay. Total polyphenols and flavonoids showed levels ranging between 421-551 mg GAE/100 g and 26.7-39.4 mg QE/100 g, respectively. Rosmarinic acid 3-glucoside, rosmarinic acid, and chlorogenic acid were the most represented polyphenols. For minerals, chia seed showed low Na and high content of Ca, Fe, Mn, Zn, and Cu. Furthermore, taking into account DRIs for adult males and females, 10 g of chia seed should cover the total requirement in Mn and Cu and half in Zn and Fe. Lipid content ranged between 32.3-39.9%. The α-linolenic acid, as expected, is the most represented fatty acid, showing values ranging between 60.34-63.85 and 35.80-47.9 g/100 g of total fatty acids for glycerolipids and polar glycerolipids, respectively. Lipid health indices showed favorable values for n-6/n-3, n-3/n-6, atherogenicity, thrombogenicity, and hypo/hypercholesterolemia. The differences observed in our investigation could have been influenced by the ambient and the cultivation conditions in the seven regions

title: Public versus Private Schooling: Pakistan's Educational Conundrum
affiliations: University of Lahore (UOL)

detail.title: Public versus Private Schooling: Pakistan's Educational Conundrum
detail.abstract: The increasing role of private institutions and corporate-style businesses in education has been a wide point of debate. However, we attempt to look at the merits and demerits of public and private education. The focus of this essay excludes higher education and discusses primary to high school education. The debate has been further narrowed to see which system would best enable the goal of achieving Universal Basic Education especially in the context of Pakistan. The analysis of effects of public, private as well as Low-Fee Private schools has been studied in order to arrive at a convincing conclusion.

declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no financial support was received for this research

detail.abstract: Social cash transfers (SCTs) are considered a priority in least-developed countries, where the gap between the need for basic social protection and existing provisions is greatest. This study represents one of the first comprehensive impact evaluation treatments for Takaful and Karamah social cash transfer programs in Egypt. The results, based on propensity score matching (PSM) and odds-weighted regression, and data from the HIECS 2017-2018, confirm positive SCTs effects on per capita non-food consumption expenditures including healthcare and education for beneficiary households. The results also indicate threshold effects with SCTs mostly impacting healthcare expenditure among asset-poorer beneficiary households and education expenditure among asset-wealthier beneficiaries.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次对埃及Takaful和Karamah社会现金转移项目进行全面影响评估，证实现金转移对受益家庭的人均非食品消费支出（包括医疗和教育）有积极影响，并发现资产水平不同的家庭在医疗和教育支出上存在阈值效应。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会保护理论和现金转移项目影响评估框架，关注消费支出模式的变化和阈值效应理论。
AI.method: 使用倾向得分匹配（PSM）和odds-weighted回归方法，基于2017-2018年埃及家庭收入、支出和消费调查（HIECS）数据。
AI.findings: 现金转移对受益家庭的人均非食品消费支出（包括医疗和教育）产生积极影响；发现阈值效应：医疗支出影响主要在资产较贫困家庭中显著，教育支出影响主要在资产较富裕家庭中显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了社会现金转移项目在中等收入国家影响的新证据，验证了消费支出模式的阈值效应理论，丰富了现金转移项目差异化影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃及政府优化社会现金转移项目设计提供实证依据，建议针对不同资产水平的家庭制定差异化支持策略，提高项目效果和资源利用效率。

title: The Time-Varying Salience Premium: Is it there?
affiliations: College of Finance and Statistics, Hunan University, Xiangtan University, College of Finance and Statistics, Hunan University and University of International Business and Economics - School of Banking and Finance

detail.title: The Time-Varying Salience Premium: Is it there?
detail.abstract: We examine whether the abnormal return of a salience-based long-short portfolio varies over time. To answer this question, our paper proposes a new semiparametric conditional factor model. This model lets alpha (abnormal return) follow a highly general form, unlike existing studies that impose specific parametric constraints.​ We use a two-step profile estimation method on monthly data from 1967 to 2024. Our results show that the salience premium has strong time variation after controlling for common risk factors. For the equal weighted salience portfolio, the abnormal return is statistically significant in most of our sample period, except for a short window around the COVID-19 pandemic.​ We also conduct nonparametric uniform tests and reject the null hypothesis that long-run abnormal returns are either zero or constant. The observed variation in the salience premium is driven by time changes in lottery preference, risk appetite, investor sentiment, and market conditions.​ However, the salience premium’s significance depends heavily on how the salience portfolio is constructed. For value-weighted salience portfolios, the premium is only significant before 1985.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于显著性特征构建的多空组合异常收益的时间变化性，提出了新的半参数条件因子模型，发现显著性溢价在控制常见风险因子后存在显著的时间变化，主要受彩票偏好、风险偏好、投资者情绪和市场条件等因素驱动。
AI.research_question: 基于显著性特征的多空组合异常收益是否随时间变化？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对异常收益施加了特定的参数约束，需要更一般化的模型来捕捉异常收益的时间变化特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半参数条件因子模型，允许alpha遵循高度一般化的形式，突破了传统参数约束的限制。
AI.method: 采用两步轮廓估计方法，使用1967-2024年月度数据进行实证分析，并进行非参数一致性检验。
AI.findings: 显著性溢价在控制常见风险因子后存在强烈的时间变化；等权重组合的异常收益在大部分样本期内显著（除COVID-19期间）；价值加权组合的溢价仅在1985年前显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的半参数条件因子模型，为研究异常收益的时间变化提供了更灵活的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了显著性溢价的时间变化规律，为投资组合构建和风险管理提供了实践指导，表明投资策略需要考虑时间变化特征。

title: Animal Spirits on Steroids: Evidence from Retail Options Trading in India
affiliations: Georgia State University - J. Mack Robinson College of Business, India Institute of Management, The Johns Hopkins Carey Business School and Lehigh University - College of Business

detail.title: Animal Spirits on Steroids: Evidence from Retail Options Trading in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We analyze a market-wide panel dataset on retail options trading from India, a market with an 80% share in option contracts traded worldwide. Retail traders both concentrated in and dominate index options trading. They exhibit short-term speculative behavior with significant day trading, shortduration directional bets especially as options converge to 0DTE and make significant losses. Three natural experiments indicate that financial constraints and lottery-like preferences likely shape investor behavior. An exogenous increase in the supply of short-maturity options induces trading. Lot-size increases and delivery margins trying to curb speculation are offset by shifts to small ticket-size, riskier options. While financial market participation increases welfare in canonical household finance models, it can also entrench speculative behavior that is difficult to undo.

AI.tldr: 印度零售期权交易者主导指数期权市场，表现出短期投机行为，主要集中在0DTE期权交易并遭受显著损失。金融约束和彩票偏好驱动其行为，监管措施效果有限，市场参与可能强化投机行为而非提升福利。
AI.research_question: 印度零售期权交易者的行为特征、驱动因素及其对市场的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 印度市场占全球期权交易量的80%，零售交易者在该市场中占据主导地位，但其行为模式和影响因素尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学理论，特别是彩票偏好理论和金融约束理论，分析零售投资者的非理性交易行为。
AI.method: 使用印度市场范围内的面板数据集，结合三个自然实验（外生短期期权供应增加、交易单位调整、交割保证金变化）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 零售交易者集中进行短期投机性交易，特别是0DTE期权，遭受显著损失；金融约束和彩票偏好是主要驱动因素；监管措施被规避，投资者转向更小面值、风险更高的期权。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了行为金融学在期权市场的应用，揭示了金融约束和彩票偏好如何共同塑造零售投资者的投机行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了重要启示：单纯的技术性监管措施可能无效，需要更深入地理解投资者行为动机来制定有效政策。

title: Viksit Bharat 2047: Contemplation of Aspirations and Challenges as We Enter 2025

detail.title: Viksit Bharat 2047: Contemplation of Aspirations and Challenges as We Enter 2025
detail.abstract: As India aspires to transition into a developed economy by 2047, this paper examines key economic indicators that highlight the disparities between India and more developed nations, particularly the United States and the United Kingdom. Utilizing data from various reputable sources, the analysis explores Gross National Income, per capita income, unemployment rates, and the Human Development Index, among other factors. In 2024, India's Gross National Income and per capita income are significantly lower than those of its developed counterparts, indicating substantial challenges ahead. The paper also highlights critical areas such as inflation rates, industrial productivity, agricultural contributions to GDP, and educational attainment, which collectively underscore the necessity for strategic economic reforms and targeted social policies. Additionally, the analysis addresses the implications of demographic trends and life expectancy disparities, reflecting on the importance of improving healthcare access and quality of life. The findings reveal that while India demonstrates considerable growth potential, achieving its developmental goals requires a unified effort to enhance economic resilience, foster social equity, and promote sustainable growth along with realistic women empowerment. This study aims to provide insights into the critical pathways India must undertake to realize its vision of becoming a developed nation by 2047.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比印度与美英等发达国家的关键经济指标，揭示了印度在国民总收入、人均收入、失业率、人类发展指数等方面的显著差距，指出印度要实现2047年成为发达国家的目标需要实施战略性经济改革和社会政策。
AI.research_question: 印度与发达国家在经济指标上的差距是什么？印度需要采取哪些关键路径才能在2047年实现成为发达国家的愿景？
AI.motivation: 印度立志在2047年转型为发达国家，但需要了解与发达国家之间的具体差距以及实现这一目标所需的关键改革措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济发展理论和国际比较研究方法，运用关键经济指标对比分析框架。
AI.method: 利用来自多个权威来源的数据，对国民总收入、人均收入、失业率、人类发展指数、通胀率、工业生产率、农业GDP贡献、教育水平等指标进行定量比较分析。
AI.findings: 印度2024年的国民总收入和人均收入显著低于发达国家；在通胀率、工业生产力、农业贡献、教育成就等方面存在明显差距；人口趋势和预期寿命差异凸显医疗保健改善的必要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了发展中国家向发达国家转型的实证分析框架，丰富了经济发展阶段理论的应用案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政府制定2047年发展目标提供了具体的政策建议，包括经济改革、社会公平促进、可持续增长和切实可行的妇女赋权策略。

title: Natural Resources Availability Could Limit Adaptive Capacity in One-Fourth of Global Crop-Producing Areas
affiliations: Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), ETH Zürich, ETH Zürich, Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK) and Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK)

detail.title: Natural Resources Availability Could Limit Adaptive Capacity in One-Fourth of Global Crop-Producing Areas
detail.abstract: Natural resources (land, water, soils, and natural vegetation) are vital for sustaining crop production and enabling adaptation to climate change. However, their role as a dimension of food systems' adaptive capacity remains underexplored. Using the global land-use model MAgPIE, we evaluate current and future availability of these resources across global crop-producing regions under three socioeconomic and climate scenarios. Currently, around 23% of global crop-producing areas could be facing low resource availability, driven by land and water overexploitation, with hotspots in the North African Mediterranean and Afghanistan. Projections display widespread declines in resources across scenarios, including sustainable pathways, particularly in South America, India, and Sub-Saharan Africa. These trends are linked to the expansion and intensification of cropland, driven by increasing income and demand for food and bioenergy. Our results underscore the pressing need to integrate sustainability and resilience into agricultural development, thereby safeguarding food security and ecosystems amid global change.

AI.tldr: 全球23%的农作物产区面临自然资源短缺问题，未来情况将进一步恶化，特别是在南美洲、印度和撒哈拉以南非洲地区，需要将可持续性和韧性纳入农业发展

AI.motivation: 自然资源对维持作物生产和适应气候变化至关重要，但其作为粮食系统适应能力维度的作用尚未得到充分探索
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然资源作为粮食系统适应能力关键维度的理论框架，使用全球土地利用模型MAgPIE
AI.method: 使用全球土地利用模型MAgPIE，在三种社会经济和气候情景下评估全球农作物产区当前和未来的自然资源可用性
AI.findings: 目前全球约23%的农作物产区面临低资源可用性，主要由土地和水资源过度开发驱动；预测显示各情景下资源普遍下降，包括可持续路径，特别是在南美洲、印度和撒哈拉以南非洲地区
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对自然资源作为粮食系统适应能力维度的理解，提供了全球尺度的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了将可持续性和韧性纳入农业发展的紧迫性，为保障全球变化背景下的粮食安全和生态系统提供了政策指导

title: A Proto-Standard for Carbon Accounting and Auditing using the E-Liability Method (v. 2)
affiliations: University of Oxford - Blavatnik School of Government, , , Yale School of Management and Harvard Business School

detail.title: A Proto-Standard for Carbon Accounting and Auditing using the E-Liability Method (v. 2)
detail.abstract: The E-liability method is an approach to accurately and verifiably account for, in as close to real time as practicable, the specific cradle-to-gate greenhouse-gas emissions embedded in any product or service that transacts in the economy. This document represents the second public version of a proto-standard for carbon accounting and auditing using the E-liability method. A number of different jurisdictions are currently attempting to develop standards for entities to calculate and report the GHG emissions embedded in their outputs, especially to have an assessment basis for planned carbon border levies. This document can serve as a complementary guide for such efforts, ensuring that standards developed in different geographies, industries, and sectors follow similar, interoperable, and conceptually sound accounting principles.

AI.tldr: E-liability方法是一种用于实时准确核算产品和服务中温室气体排放的碳会计方法，本文提供了该方法的第二个公开版本原型标准，旨在为不同司法管辖区的碳边境税提供统一的核算基础。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个统一、可互操作且概念合理的碳会计标准来准确核算产品和服务的温室气体排放？
AI.motivation: 多个司法管辖区正在尝试制定计算和报告温室气体排放的标准，特别是为计划的碳边境税提供评估基础，需要统一的核算原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: E-liability碳会计方法理论框架，基于实时核算和可验证的温室气体排放追踪原则。
AI.method: 提出E-liability方法的原型标准开发，作为碳会计和审计的指导框架。
AI.findings: 开发了E-liability方法的第二个公开版本，可作为不同地区、行业和部门制定标准的补充指南。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了概念合理的碳会计理论框架，为温室气体排放核算提供了统一的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为碳边境税的实施提供了可操作的核算标准，确保不同地理区域和行业的碳会计标准具有互操作性。
