title: Lasting Growth of Cities: Challenges of Infrastructure Rehabilitation in Ukraine
affiliations: Zhytomyr Polytechnic State University, Poltava V.G.Korolenko National Pedagogical University, National University "Yuri Kondratyuk Poltava Polytechnic", West Ukrainian National University and Interregional Academy of Personnel Management

detail.title: Lasting Growth of Cities: Challenges of Infrastructure Rehabilitation in Ukraine

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 18 (11), 303-310, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: The large-scale destruction of industrial, energy and infrastructure facilities during the war has a destructive impact on social development and the progress of the business sector. The European integration concept of Ukraine's postwar recovery envisages active reconstruction of cities based on sustainable development. The article aims to analyse the scale of infrastructure destruction in Ukraine during the war and its impact on sustainable urban development. The study identifies potential risks for the urban development strategy caused by infrastructure destruction. The system of management of reconstruction projects and the state of coordination of management activities in this aspect are investigated. The need to transfer modern approaches generally accepted in the international community to upgrade local management structures for urban development is determined. The necessity of improving the regulatory framework in this aspect is substantiated. The potential of the energy security system against the background of the risks of damage to urban infrastructure is investigated. The sectoral objectives included in Goal 11 of the General Strategy for Sustainable Development-Sustainable Development of Cities and Communities-are analysed. It is established that these tasks aim to ensure the openness, safety and environmental sustainability of cities. It is proved that large-scale destruction of infrastructure, including critical infrastructure, causes instability in socioeconomic development, destroys the environment, and worsens the investment climate. It is established that optimisation of the urban development strategy in wartime should aim at integration into global economic networks, transfer of the latest technologies, integration of "green" initiatives, and intensification of social participation in urban development initiatives, which has become an integral component of the process of building an adaptive and sustainable modern city.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了乌克兰战争期间基础设施破坏的规模及其对城市可持续发展的影响，探讨了重建项目管理体系和协调机制，提出了将国际先进管理方法引入地方城市发展管理的必要性，并论证了优化战时城市发展战略的方向。

AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰战后重建提供了具体的战略建议，包括管理结构升级、法规框架完善、能源安全保障和社会参与机制建设等实践指导。

detail.title: Human Capital Policy in Science and Technology

detail.abstract: Brain-circulation; Brain-drain; Entrepreneurship; Governance of science and technology; Human capital development strategies; Knowledge creation and exchange; Social development; Transnational research collaborations; Use and application of science and technology Definition Human capital is the productive wealth embodied in labor, skills, and knowledge of science and technology. The terminology for policies covering human capital policy varies in countries. They are often called science and technology policy, research and innovation policy, or higher education, science, and innovation policy. Common for all is that they include set of beliefs and practices designed and implemented to stimulate the production of scientific and technological knowledge in order to realize the ideal of progress and welfare in countries.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人力资本政策（包括科技政策、研究创新政策等）如何通过促进科技知识生产来实现国家进步和福利，重点关注脑力循环、脑力流失、创业、科技治理等关键概念。

title: Stackdid: Stacked Difference-in-Differences Regression
affiliations: North Carolina State University

detail.title: Stackdid: Stacked Difference-in-Differences Regression
detail.abstract: This paper introduces stackdid, a new, community-contributed Stata command that makes implementing stacked difference-indifferences regressions remarkably straightforward. stackdid handles all the complexity of restructuring panel data into "stacks" of "cohorts" centered on treatment events and performs the specified regression. It integrates seamlessly with existing high-dimensional fixed effects estimators and supports both linear and Poisson specifications, allowing researchers to adapt their preferred specifications to the stacked framework with ease. stackdid provides an assortment of options enabling precise model specification and robustness analysis. This command provides researchers with an accessible, practical tool for implementing the stacked difference-indifferences methodology, contributing to the growing toolkit for robust causal inference with differential treatment timing.

AI.tldr: stackdid是一个新的Stata命令，简化了堆叠双重差分回归的实现过程，自动处理面板数据重组和回归分析，支持多种模型规格和稳健性检验

AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了实用的工具，支持精确模型设定和稳健性分析，促进了因果推断方法的应用

title: A Critical Evaluation of Rules-Based Approaches: From Macrostability to Macroprudential Supervision: 1993-2023
affiliations: The Open University - Business School

detail.title: A Critical Evaluation of Rules-Based Approaches: From Macrostability to Macroprudential Supervision: 1993-2023
detail.abstract: In this paper, the author critically evaluates the 30-year interval between 1993-2023 by analysing the evidence found in the literature on conventions at the macro-level. The paper critiques the so-called rules-based approach of contemporary policy choice and questions the direction of its intended course. The paper uses the governance framework taken from the ISSB's Disclosure and Non-Financial Reporting approach to illustrate, comparatively, and then highlights how the Taylor model of inflation targeting creates uncertainty, due partly to an inherent adherence by policymakers to prescriptive rules (Orphanides, 2001). This paper concludes by attempting to illustrate how by not internalising a risk-based approach (in favour of a rulesbased approach), UK and US monetary policy conventions have underestimated an indirect cause of inflationary regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了1993-2023年30年间基于规则的货币政策方法，指出泰勒规则的通胀目标制因过度依赖规定性规则而制造不确定性，并论证英美货币政策因未采用基于风险的方法而低估了通胀体制的间接原因。
AI.research_question: 基于规则的当代政策选择方法是否有效？其方向是否正确？
AI.motivation: 对过去30年宏观层面政策惯例的批判性评估需求，以及对规则导向政策方法的质疑
AI.theoretical_framework: ISSB披露和非财务报告方法的治理框架，泰勒通胀目标模型，基于风险的方法与基于规则的方法对比
AI.method: 文献分析，比较分析，批判性评估
AI.findings: 泰勒模型的通胀目标制因政策制定者对规定性规则的内在坚持而制造不确定性；英美货币政策因偏好基于规则的方法而非基于风险的方法，低估了通胀体制的间接原因
AI.theory_contributions: 对基于规则的货币政策方法提出理论批判，强调基于风险方法的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于货币政策惯例选择的实践启示，指出当前方法可能存在的缺陷和改进方向

detail.title: Job Satisfaction Impact of Technological Change on Women Garment Workers in Bangladesh

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Business Administration, Vol. 29, No. 1 & 2, January & April 2003

detail.abstract: This study analyzes the impact of technological change on job satisfaction of women garment workers in Bangladesh. A set of job satisfaction variables was developed from the Technological Change Survey (Slem and Levi, 1995). The specific relationship between job satisfaction and the overall satisfaction shows that fair pay, task significance, bureaucracy, conflicts, and information sharing are significantly related. Task significance and information sharing are positively related to the overall impact. Fair pay, bureaucracy and conflicts are negatively and significantly related to the overall impact.

AI.research_question: 技术变革如何影响孟加拉国女性服装工人的工作满意度？

title: The Medieval Origins of Spousal Consent
affiliations: University of Mississippi - Department of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Medieval Origins of Spousal Consent
detail.abstract: This paper examines the medieval origins of spousal consent, the norm requiring that marriages be contracted willingly and free from pressure from third parties. We argue that this norm resulted from the Catholic Church's consolidation of legal authority over marriage in the 11th-12th centuries. Committed doctrinally to the belief that marriages could not be dissolved and that remarriage was therefore impermissible (i.e., marriage indissolubility), the Church was compelled to enforce high consent requirements to the formation of new unions. Using a simple theoretical model, we show that the Church's optimal level of spousal consent is higher when remarriage is not allowed. Higher consent requirements mitigate the negative effect of indissolubility on the number of marriages contracted. The development of a theory of spousal consent marked a sharp break from pre-Christian practice, which gave parents substantial control over the choice of spouse. It also contrasted with Eastern Orthodoxy and Protestantism, both of which permitted remarriage after divorce. Our analysis suggests that the Church's insistence on free consent was a necessary institutional complement to its unique stance on indissolubility, shaping marriage law and family structure in ways that reverberated throughout European history.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了中世纪配偶同意原则的起源，认为这是天主教会11-12世纪巩固婚姻法律权威的结果。教会的婚姻不可解除教义要求高标准的同意要求，以缓解不可解除性对婚姻数量的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 配偶同意原则（要求婚姻必须基于双方自愿且不受第三方压力的规范）是如何在中世纪产生的？
AI.motivation: 理解天主教会在婚姻法发展中的独特作用，以及其婚姻不可解除教义如何塑造了欧洲的家庭结构和婚姻制度

AI.method: 使用简单的理论模型分析教会的最优同意水平，并进行历史比较分析

AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了中世纪婚姻制度演变的历史机制，为理解欧洲家庭结构的历史发展提供了新的视角

title: Violence at School
affiliations: School of Government, Pontificia Universidad Catolica, Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile and World Bank

detail.title: Violence at School

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper estimates the impact of violence perpetrated by peers and school staff on student victims. Leveraging unique administrative data from Chile that links reports of school violence to individual educational records, we address longstanding data limitations that have constrained empirical research on this issue. Using a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that exposure to school violence has persistent negative effects: absenteeism increases by 4664\%, grade retention rates double, and both grades and test scores decline significantly, with impacts lasting up to four years. In the longer term, victims are substantially less likely to graduate from high school or enroll in university, with violence perpetrated by adults having more severe consequences than peer violence. Complementary survey evidence reveals that reported incidents are associated with increased perceptions of violence and discrimination, as well as decreases in school belonging and teacher expectations. While these psychological and perceptual effects tend to fade after one year, the adverse educational consequences persist, underscoring how brief traumatic experiences can lead to long-lasting educational disadvantages.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文使用智利行政数据和匹配双重差分法，发现学校暴力对学生造成持久性负面教育影响，包括缺勤增加、留级率提高、成绩下降，以及高中毕业和大学入学概率减少，而且教师暴力比同伴暴力影响更严重。
AI.research_question: 学校暴力（来自同伴和教师的暴力）对学生受害者的教育成果产生了什么影响？这些影响的持续时间有多长？
AI.motivation: 过往研究受限于数据限制，无法精确估计学校暴力对学生教育成果的持久性影响，本研究利用智利的行政数据链接来充分解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育经济学和心理学理论，考察激烈事件对个体学习动机、心理健康和教育投资决策的长期影响机制。
AI.method: 采用匹配双重差分设计（Matched Difference-in-Differences），利用智利行政数据将学校暴力报告与个人教育记录相链接，并进行补充性调查验证。
AI.findings: 1、暴力体验导致缺勤率增加46-64%，留级率倍增；2、成绩和考试分数显著下降，影响持续至4年；3、高中毕业和大学入学概率显著降低；4、教师暴力比同伴暴力后果更严重；5、心理感知影响一年后渐淡，但教育后果持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 为短暂痛苦经历导致长期教育劣势的机制提供了实证证据，完善了学校暴力教育影响的理论框架，特别是区分了不同施暴者类型的异质性效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了具体的干预依据，强调了防范教师暴力的重要性，建议学校建立暴力事件的及时反应和干预机制。

title: The Procedural Rights in Tax Administrative Legislation System: Evidence of the Emerging Economy

detail.title: The Procedural Rights in Tax Administrative Legislation System: Evidence of the Emerging Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Corporate Law and Governance Review, volume 5, issue 2, 2023[10.22495/clgrv5i2p2 ]

detail.abstract: Procedural rights in the tax administration deal with the rules and procedures that help citizens and businesses comply with their tax obligations to the state. ―The tax administration system consists of state bodies that have the right to collect revenues for the budget, and a set of rules and regulations that govern the tax procedure in the country‖ (Temchyshyna, 2022, p. 206). This study aims to treat the procedural rights in tax administration in theoretical aspects and comparative aspects, through Balkan countries. The research model was based on qualitative research, based on normative method, comparative method, analytic method, and descriptive method, all of these methods based on credible sources, like legal acts, scientific papers, official reports from official bodies, and non-government organizations. Furthermore, this study aims to make a review analysis of the procedural rights that are missing in the tax administrative legislation system in Kosovo, identify and treat the theoretical aspects of procedural rights of taxpayers in tax administration in general, and analyze challenges of tax administration in actuality and general. The main findings of the study show that the Tax Administration of Kosovo has made great progress by modernizing itself and simplifying its procedures for tax-paying citizens.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过理论分析和巴尔干国家比较，探讨税务管理中的程序性权利，重点分析科索沃税务立法体系中缺失的程序性权利，并发现科索沃税务局在现代化和简化程序方面取得显著进展。
AI.research_question: 税务管理中的程序性权利在理论层面和巴尔干国家比较层面的表现如何？科索沃税务立法体系中缺失哪些程序性权利？
AI.motivation: 探讨税务管理中程序性权利的理论基础和实际应用，通过比较分析识别科索沃税务体系的不足并提出改进建议。

AI.method: 定性研究方法，包括规范分析法、比较分析法、分析法和描述法，基于法律文件、科学论文、官方报告和非政府组织报告等可信来源
AI.findings: 科索沃税务局在现代化和简化税务程序方面取得重大进展，为纳税人提供了更好的服务
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对税务管理程序性权利的理论理解，建立了巴尔干国家税务权利比较分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了科索沃税务立法体系中缺失的程序性权利，为税务管理改革提供具体建议，促进纳税人权利保护

title: There Is Nothing We Can Do" For Some And "I Can Do Everything" For Others: AI Revolution, Perceived Behavioral Control Across Social Classes in the D.R.Congo
affiliations: Université Libre des Pays des Grands Lacs

detail.title: There Is Nothing We Can Do" For Some And "I Can Do Everything" For Others: AI Revolution, Perceived Behavioral Control Across Social Classes in the D.R.Congo
detail.abstract: Anticipating disruptive technologies often reveals deep social divides in how individuals interpret change. This paper examines the psychological consequences of imagining an Artificial Intelligence (AI) revolution in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with particular attention to perceived behavioral control (PBC). Drawing on the Theory of Planned Behavior, we conceptualize PBC through two key dimensions: self-efficacy and locus of control. Using a randomized experimental design with treatment, placebo, and control conditions, participants were primed with narratives of AI disruption, after which shifts in their sense of agency were measured. Findings indicate that AI primes significantly reduced perceptions of controllability, especially among disadvantaged groups, while self-efficacy remained largely stable. Conversely, individuals with relative advantages, proxied by car ownership and male gender, demonstrated resilience, and in certain cases even a rebound effect, suggesting that access to material and symbolic resources protects against the disempowering effects of disruptive change. These results underscore a critical psychological cleavage: whereas advantaged participants are inclined to view AI as opportunity, marginalized participants experience it as an uncontrollable threat. The study contributes to debates on inequality, perceived behavioral control, and technology adoption by revealing how social class moderates psychological responses to anticipated technological transformations. Policy implications emphasize that reducing inequality requires not only digital infrastructure and skill-building, but also the cultivation of psychological resources such as Locus of control, inclusion, and self-efficacy to mitigate the risk of AI amplifying existing divides.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI技术革命对刚果民主共和国不同社会阶层人群心理控制感的影响，发现AI叙事会显著降低弱势群体的可控性感知，而优势群体则表现出心理韧性甚至反弹效应，揭示了社会阶层在技术变革心理反应中的调节作用。
AI.research_question: AI技术革命如何影响不同社会阶层人群的感知行为控制（PBC），特别是自我效能感和控制点两个维度？
AI.motivation: 预测颠覆性技术往往揭示个体对变革解释的深层社会分歧，需要理解AI革命对不同社会群体的心理影响，特别是在资源不平等的发展中国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behavior），重点关注感知行为控制的两个关键维度：自我效能感（self-efficacy）和控制点（locus of control）。
AI.method: 采用随机实验设计，设置处理组、安慰剂组和对照组，通过AI颠覆性叙事启动参与者，然后测量其能动性感知的变化。
AI.findings: AI启动显著降低了可控性感知，特别是在弱势群体中，而自我效能感保持相对稳定。优势群体（以汽车所有权和男性性别为代理变量）表现出韧性甚至反弹效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会阶层在调节技术变革心理反应中的作用，扩展了计划行为理论在技术采纳和 inequality 研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示强调减少不平等不仅需要数字基础设施和技能建设，还需要培养心理资源（如控制点、包容性和自我效能感）来缓解AI放大现有鸿沟的风险。

title: How to Achieve the “Desirable Futures” in Anticipatory Democracy by using Anticipatory Systems. Lessons Cinematography and Filmmaking Can Teach Us (Presentation Slides)

detail.title: How to Achieve the “Desirable Futures” in Anticipatory Democracy by using Anticipatory Systems. Lessons Cinematography and Filmmaking Can Teach Us (Presentation Slides)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author states she has no personal or financial relationship with no people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced her study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The experiments are virtual and needed not patients' or participants' ethics approval as the public data was used for analysis.

keywords: Virtual and Immersive Environments" V135: "Desirable Futures: Cinematography
Anticipation and Political Cultures" Chair: Camelia Florela Voinea Co-Chair: Bruno Daniel Perreira Costa

detail.abstract:
This paper presents a research approach on anticipatory democracy which addresses the methodology for computing the “desirable futures”, a basic concept in Anticipatory Democracy studies (Bezolt, 1978, 2010). The paper elaborates on the build-up of a computational and simulation model for computing the desirable future in anticipatory social-political systems. The research is aimed for the study of hybrid social-political systems defined as anticipatory systems and can be further developed for virtual and immersive social-political anticipatory systems.

This paper provides a anticipatory democracy research approach on achieving desirable futures (aspirational futures) in a social-political system defined as a hybrid environment, where the term ‘hybrid environment’ defines a social-political environment which includes both physical and virtual space and time dimensions, and the term ‘anticipatory system’ is the definition of a complex social-political system with an internal model of itself which employs it for achieving reflexivity and computing the future state(s) (Rosen 1985, p.341; Dubois, 1998a, b; Leydesdorff and Dubois, 2004; Dubois, 2020).

The approach reported in this paper is a research methodology approach based on early theory and methodology in (i) modelling and simulation of political culture by value mappings (Voinea, 2021a, b; 2022a, b), and (ii) mathematical and computational modelling of anticipatory systems (Dubois, 1998a, b; Dubois and Resconi, 1993; Dubois, 2001).  The research approach on the modelling of a hybrid social-political anticipatory system in this paper is inspired by the theories on time and spatialization of time from classic and contemporary film theory and cinematography (Panofsky, 1934/1947; Deleuze, 1985/1989; Elsaesser, 2009). Filmmaking can teach us two lessons about how to employ space and time in order to explain and provide for a desirable future state of an evolving complex social-political environment (Dunat, 2022; Yaffe, 2003; Deleuze, 1985/1989; Bluestone, 1961). The approach in this paper adapts the concepts of ‘time’ and ‘space’ in film theory to the simulation and computation of a anticipatory system for achieving the desirable future state of the system. The paper suggests a methodology which employs multiple space locations and time segments for the study of desirable futures in an experimental scenario of mass participation to political protests in hybrid social-political environments.

This research approach proves relevant for the research on hybrid, virtual and immersive anticipatory systems in areas with high emotional intensity and stress, like healthcare, financial markets, and art industries with high emotional and cultural impact like movie industry. It addresses research issues like meaning co-creation, value co-creation, and design of aspirational futures in social and political environments.

Our approach emphasizes a difference from the classic mathematical and computational model of anticipatory systems: it brings a multiple space and time segments approach in order to operationalize the participation of individuals in mass political protests in hybrid social-political environments. Our approach adapts concepts and theories about time and space from film theory such that the multiple space and time dimensions representing the many individuals’ participation in political phenomena could be appropriately used in the definition, description and operationalization of hybrid social-political systems defined as anticipatory systems. The approach has been employed for the computation of desirable futures in a Case Study on Romanian phenomena of political regime change in 1989 by employing visual and content analysis of data extracted from the 1989 Romanian Anti-Communism Revolution TV-Streaming on Romanian National Television channel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于电影理论的时空多维度计算方法，用于计算混合社会政治预期系统中的理想未来状态，并在罗马尼亚1989年政权变革案例中进行了验证。
AI.research_question: 如何计算混合社会政治预期系统中的理想未来状态？
AI.motivation: 传统预期系统数学模型在应对混合环境（物理与虚拟空间时间维度并存）中的大规模政治参与现象时存在局限，需要新的方法论来操作化个体参与和计算理想未来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期民主理论（Bezolt）、预期系统理论（Rosen, Dubois）、电影理论中的时空概念（Panofsky, Deleuze）、政治文化价值映射模型（Voinea）
AI.method: 基于电影理论的多时空维度计算方法，结合可视化与内容分析，通过罗马尼亚1989年反共产主义革命电视直播数据进行案例研究
AI.findings: 提出的多时空维度方法能够有效操作化混合环境中大规模政治参与现象，成功计算出理想未来状态，验证了方法在高压情感强度环境中的适用性
AI.theory_contributions: 将电影理论中的时空概念引入预期系统研究，拓展了预期民主理论的方法论体系，为混合预期系统提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗保健、金融市场、电影产业等高情感强度领域的混合预期系统提供了可操作的研究方法，支持意义共创、价值共创和理想未来设计

title: The Impact of EAC Customs Union On Rwanda’s Customs Revenues
affiliations: National University of Rwanda

detail.title: The Impact of EAC Customs Union On Rwanda’s Customs Revenues

contentType.other: Thesis for obtaining a Mater's degree

detail.abstract:
This study was carried out to find out the impact of EAC Customs Union on Rwanda’s customs revenues.

The general objective of this study was to verify the impact of EAC Customs Union on Rwanda’s customs revenues, while the specific objectives were to identify the share of tariffs in the Government revenues and to find out ways Rwandan government shall use to find and/or mobilize new resources to compensate the tariff revenue losses due to EAC Customs Union.

The study used a convenience sampling method to select customs offices from which sample individuals would be got after determining a sample size of 95 customs offices staffs using simple random sampling technique where necessary.

To collect the necessary data both primary and secondary sources were used namely questionnaire and documentary study techniques and collected data have been analyzed using SPSS (Statistical Package for Social Sciences).

Research findings revealed that, customs revenues have a great share in the total government tax revenue, and this share has decreased after the Rwanda join to the EAC Customs Union. This is to indicate that Rwanda suffered a loss in customs revenue. Therefore, the null hypothesis of this research which stated that the East African Community Customs Union has a negative impact on Rwanda’s customs revenues was not rejected.

Even though the means by which the Rwandan government will use to compensate the loss in revenue were found out, the impact still persists.

The ways to cover the revenue loss faced by Rwanda due to the implementation of EAC Customs Union were recommended.

Finally, the researcher recommended to carry out a further research on the impact of EAC Customs Union on Partner States’ customs revenues.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨东非共同体关税同盟对卢旺达关税收入的影响，发现关税在政府税收中占比较大但加入后份额下降，卢旺达遭受关税收入损失，零假设未被拒绝。
AI.research_question: 东非共同体关税同盟对卢旺达关税收入的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 验证EAC关税同盟对卢旺达关税收入的影响，识别关税在政府收入中的份额，寻找补偿关税收入损失的新资源筹集方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税同盟理论，收入效应分析
AI.method: 便利抽样法选择海关办公室，简单随机抽样95名海关工作人员，问卷和文献研究收集数据，SPSS进行数据分析
AI.findings: 关税在政府税收收入中占比较大，加入EAC关税同盟后份额下降，卢旺达遭受关税收入损失，零假设未被拒绝
AI.theory_contributions: 为关税同盟理论在发展中国家特别是非洲地区的应用提供实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为卢旺达政府提供补偿关税收入损失的具体建议，为其他EAC成员国提供政策参考

title: Building Resilience, Ethics, and Emotional Skills in Children: A Guide for Educators and Parents
affiliations: Founder, SHADOW

detail.title: Building Resilience, Ethics, and Emotional Skills in Children: A Guide for Educators and Parents
detail.abstract: Children's mental health and social-emotional well-being are critical global priorities. Recent data show that roughly one in seven adolescents experience significant mental health conditions (World Health Organization, 2025). Yet many primary schools, especially in low-resource contexts, lack structured programs to foster resilience, empathy, and ethical behavior. For example, UNICEF reports that Bangladesh has begun integrating mental health support into the national curriculum (United Nations Children's Fund [UNICEF], 2025), yet educators often still lack formal SEL training (Reza, 2024). This mixed-methods study surveyed primary students (ages 6-11) in Bangladesh, along with their teachers and parents, to identify gaps in SEL awareness and practices. The study found that adults recognize the importance of social-emotional learning but often feel unprepared, while children commonly struggled with anger management, empathy, and understanding fairness. The study proposes a dual-level intervention framework. The first level is a training curriculum for teachers and parents, covering child development, resilience-building, emotional coaching, and ethical reasoning. The second level is an age-appropriate SEL roadmap for students in Classes 1-5, using games, role-play, and stories to build emotional vocabulary and moral skills step by step. Together, these modules aim to strengthen children's coping strategies, improve classroom and home environments, and promote children's long-term well-being.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对孟加拉国小学生社会情感学习(SEL)缺失问题，通过混合方法研究发现成人和儿童在SEL方面存在认知与实践差距，提出了包含教师家长培训课程和学生分年级SEL路线图的双层干预框架。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国小学阶段社会情感学习(SEL)的认知与实践差距是什么？如何设计有效的干预框架来提升学生的社会情感能力和心理健康？
AI.motivation: 全球约七分之一的青少年面临心理健康问题，但许多资源匮乏地区的小学缺乏系统的社会情感学习项目。孟加拉国虽已将心理健康支持纳入国家课程，但教育者仍缺乏正式的SEL培训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会情感学习理论、儿童发展心理学、情绪调节理论和道德发展理论，构建包含认知、情感和行为维度的综合干预框架。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：对孟加拉国6-11岁小学生及其教师和家长进行问卷调查和深度访谈，识别SEL意识和实践方面的差距。
AI.findings: 成人认识到SEL的重要性但缺乏准备，儿童普遍在愤怒管理、共情能力和公平理解方面存在困难。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于资源匮乏环境的社会情感学习双层干预理论框架，整合了成人培训与学生课程的系统性方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了具体的教师家长培训课程(涵盖儿童发展、韧性建设、情绪辅导和道德推理)和学生分年级SEL路线图(通过游戏、角色扮演和故事逐步建立情绪词汇和道德技能)。

title: When Do Consumers Lose from Variable Electricity Pricing?
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Laboratory for Information and Decision Systems

detail.title: When Do Consumers Lose from Variable Electricity Pricing?
detail.abstract:
Time-varying electricity pricing better reflects the varying cost of electricity compared to flat-rate pricing. Variations between peak and off-peak costs are increasing due to weather variation, renewable intermittency, and increasing electrification of demand. Empirical and theoretical studies suggest that variable pricing can lower electricity supply costs and reduce grid stress. However, the distributional impacts, particularly on low-income consumers, remain understudied. This paper develops a theoretical framework to analyze how consume heterogeneity affects welfare outcomes when electricity markets transition from flat-rate to time-varying pricing, considering realistic assumptions about heterogeneous consumer demand, supply costs, and utility losses from unmet consumption.

We derive sufficient conditions for identifying when consumers lose utility from pricing reforms and compare welfare effects across consumer types. Our findings reveal that consumer vulnerability depends on the interaction of consumption timing, demand flexibility capabilities, and price sensitivity levels. Consumers with high peak-period consumption and inflexible demand, characteristics often associated with low-income households, are most vulnerable to welfare losses. Critically, we demonstrate that demand flexibility provides welfare protection only when coincident with large price changes, a condition more easily met by higher-income consumers in most empirical studies. Our equilibrium analysis reveals that aggregate flexibility patterns generate spillover effects through pricing mechanisms, with peak periods experiencing greater price changes when they have less aggregate flexibility, potentially concentrating larger price increases among vulnerable populations that have a limited ability to respond. These findings suggest that variable pricing policies designed to support clean energy transitions risk exacerbating energy inequality unless accompanied by targeted policies ensuring equitable access to demand response capabilities and pricing benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个理论框架分析电力市场从固定电价转向分时电价时消费者异质性对福利结果的影响，发现低收入消费者由于高峰用电多且需求灵活性差，最容易遭受福利损失，需求灵活性只有在价格变化大时才能提供保护，而这种情况通常只有高收入消费者才能满足。
AI.research_question: 消费者异质性如何影响电力市场从固定电价转向分时电价时的福利结果？
AI.motivation: 分时电价能更好反映电力成本变化，但对其分配效应特别是对低收入消费者的影响研究不足，需要理解不同消费者类型在电价改革中的福利变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者异质性理论，考虑不同消费者的需求时间模式、需求灵活性和价格敏感度差异，构建理论模型分析电价改革的福利分配效应。
AI.method: 理论框架开发，推导消费者在电价改革中效用损失的充分条件，比较不同消费者类型的福利效应，进行均衡分析。
AI.findings: 消费者脆弱性取决于消费时间、需求灵活性和价格敏感度的交互作用；高峰用电多且需求不灵活的消费者（通常是低收入家庭）最易遭受福利损失；需求灵活性只有在价格变化大时才能提供保护；总体灵活性模式通过定价机制产生溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了分析电价改革分配效应的理论框架，揭示了消费者异质性对福利结果的影响机制，阐明了需求灵活性保护作用的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出分时电价政策如无配套措施可能加剧能源不平等，建议制定针对性政策确保需求响应能力和定价利益的公平获取，支持清洁能源转型的公平性。

title: Commercial Christmas Cheer: The Reestablishment and Proliferation of Christmas Markets in Post-World War II Germany (1945–2020)
affiliations: Charles Sturt University - Gulbali Institute for Agriculture, Water and Environment, Charles Sturt University

detail.title: Commercial Christmas Cheer: The Reestablishment and Proliferation of Christmas Markets in Post-World War II Germany (1945–2020)
detail.abstract: Originating in the Middle Ages as venues for purchasing supplies and goods in preparation of the midwinter season, Christmas markets have morphed into a multi-sensory experiential events and social venues. Christmas markets have been publicised as the quintessential event in Germany leading up to Christmas, with the over 2000 locations attracting large numbers of local, domestic and international visitors. Yet, after World War I such markets were becoming obsolete, only to be revived by Nazi politicians in the late 1930s. Drawing on a dataset of dates of commencement or more than 1000 German communities specifically compiled for this study, this paper traces the history of the Christmas markets from the immediate post-World War II period until the COVID-19 ('Corona') pandemic of 2020 which saw a temporary cessation of all markets. The paper argues that these markets played an important role during the period of postwar austerity and the early economic recovery, but that thereafter many became an anachronism. Only the wave of nostalgia that followed the oil shock of 1973 and the period of social and economic change of the early 1970s saw a resurgence and rapid expansion of Christmas markets that gradually grew into the social, experiential phenomenon that we know today.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了德国圣诞市场从二战后到2020年COVID-19疫情期间的历史发展，分析了其在战后紧缩时期的重要作用，1970年代石油危机后的怀旧浪潮推动的复兴，以及最终发展成为现代多感官体验活动的过程。
AI.research_question: 德国圣诞市场在二战后至2020年期间经历了怎样的历史演变过程？
AI.motivation: 圣诞市场作为德国典型的节庆活动，从中世纪的物资采购场所演变为现代多感官体验活动，但其在二战后到现代的发展历程尚未得到系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史演变理论、怀旧消费理论、节庆活动发展理论
AI.method: 基于专门编制的1000多个德国社区圣诞市场开办日期的数据集进行历史分析
AI.findings: 1) 圣诞市场在战后紧缩时期和早期经济复苏中发挥重要作用；2) 此后许多市场变得过时；3) 1973年石油危机后的怀旧浪潮推动了圣诞市场的复兴和快速扩张；4) 逐渐发展成为今天的社会体验现象
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了节庆活动历史演变的理论理解，提供了怀旧消费推动传统文化复兴的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为节庆活动管理者和政策制定者提供了历史经验，有助于理解传统文化活动的可持续发展路径

title: Climate Projections Affect Restoration Priorities: Application to Brazilian Forests
affiliations: American University of Armenia

detail.title: Climate Projections Affect Restoration Priorities: Application to Brazilian Forests
detail.abstract: While ecological dynamics have been shown to affect restoration targeting decisions, the impact of climate change on the economic value of restoration remains less explored. Climate change can be expected to affect both the benefits and costs of a particular restoration project, through changing crop yields, vegetation, and urbanization, among other factors, potentially leading to abandonment of sites or forgone opportunity. Here, we first present a framework for understanding the effect of projected changes on the economic value of a restoration project. We then apply the model to an empirical context of interest: habitat restoration via forest replanting in Brazil, focusing on the implications of two specific climate projections: changing crop yields and changing forest cover habitat. We find that active restoration would yield net benefits in a majority of grid cells across the country, monetizing benefits of restored lands by considering habitat value alone, yet that integrating projections of conditions in 2050 yields greater expected benefits than present conditions would suggest, with an increase in the median grid cell of 41 percent and significant spatial variation. Our results illustrate the importance of accounting for projected changes in conditions in restoration planning, and support for the economic value of wide-scale restoration programs which provide biodiversity protection.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了气候变化对巴西森林恢复项目经济价值的影响，发现考虑2050年气候预测的恢复项目预期收益比当前条件高出41%，强调了在恢复规划中纳入气候变化因素的重要性。
AI.research_question: 气候变化如何影响森林恢复项目的经济价值？
AI.motivation: 虽然生态动态已被证明会影响恢复目标决策，但气候变化对恢复经济价值的影响仍较少被探索。气候变化通过改变作物产量、植被和城市化等因素，可能影响特定恢复项目的收益和成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出了一个理解预测变化对恢复项目经济价值影响的框架，考虑了气候变化对收益和成本的双重影响。
AI.method: 将模型应用于巴西森林重新造林的栖息地恢复实证背景，重点分析两种具体气候预测的影响：变化的作物产量和变化的森林覆盖栖息地。
AI.findings: 主动恢复在巴西大多数网格单元中会产生净收益；整合2050年条件预测的预期收益比当前条件高出41%，且存在显著的空间差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了气候变化背景下评估恢复项目经济价值的分析框架，为理解气候因素对生态恢复经济性的影响提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果支持大规模恢复计划的经济价值，强调了在恢复规划中考虑预测条件变化的重要性，为决策者提供了基于气候变化的恢复投资决策依据。

title: The Psychology of Competition Agencies: From Motivated Skepticism to Hopeful Pessimism Toward Complex Economic Evidence
affiliations: Compass Lexecon

detail.title: The Psychology of Competition Agencies: From Motivated Skepticism to Hopeful Pessimism Toward Complex Economic Evidence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The paper is sole responsibility of the author and does not represent the views of Compass Lexecon, its experts and clients.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper has not been commissioned or funded by any party, and no party had the right to review the paper prior to its circulation.

detail.abstract: In this paper we present a theory which purports to explain why competition regulators may choose to sacrifice decision accuracy, adopting pessimistic beliefs about firms' conduct-beliefs that overestimate the likelihood of firm infringement and underestimate non-infringement-and ignoring economic evidence contradicting those beliefs. Unlike models where beliefs are assumed exogenous, here beliefs are treated as endogenous and potentially shaped by institutional, personal, or contextual factors. In a nutshell, we argue that agencies' skepticism is not the result of mis-information, but rather is driven by cognitive dissonance, reinforced by cultural capture, stereotypical thinking, and viral political narratives: morality tales and conspiracy theories. Surprisingly, perhaps, their skepticism may prove consumer and total welfare increasing, though at the cost of accuracy and at the expense of compliant firms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个理论解释竞争监管机构为何可能牺牲决策准确性，采用对企业行为的悲观信念（高估侵权可能性、低估非侵权可能性），并忽视与之矛盾的经济证据。该理论认为这种怀疑态度不是信息错误的结果，而是由认知失调驱动，并受到文化俘获、刻板思维和病毒式政治叙事的强化。
AI.research_question: 为什么竞争监管机构会选择牺牲决策准确性，采用对企业行为的悲观信念并忽视相反的经济证据？
AI.motivation: 解释监管机构在竞争执法中表现出的系统性偏见行为模式，这些行为无法用传统的外生信念模型充分解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知失调理论、文化俘获理论、刻板思维理论、病毒式政治叙事理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，将信念作为内生变量而非外生给定，分析机构信念形成的机制和影响因素
AI.findings: 监管机构的怀疑态度是由认知失调驱动，受到文化俘获、刻板思维和政治叙事的强化；这种怀疑态度可能提高消费者福利和总福利，但以牺牲准确性和合规企业利益为代价
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将信念内生的新理论框架，解释了监管机构系统性偏见的行为模式，丰富了监管行为理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解监管决策偏差提供了新视角，对改进监管实践和减少误判具有重要启示意义

title: Are Highways Conduits or Barriers for Urban Travelers? A Welfare Analysis Using Smartphone Data

detail.title: Are Highways Conduits or Barriers for Urban Travelers? A Welfare Analysis Using Smartphone Data
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of highways on intracity travel using granular smartphone GPS data. I find that urban highways act as barriers to travel: conditional on travel time, destinations reached by crossing highways are 24.9% less likely to be chosen, and those reached by using highways are 23.5% less likely. The impacts are stronger for short, consumption trips and weaker for commuting. Using a quantitative urban model that integrates both work and consumption travel, I evaluate the welfare effects of two counterfactual highway systems that remove the estimated disamenities. Both scenarios yield welfare gains of at least 9%. These gains arise from improved access to urban amenities, which strengthens agglomeration as population, employment, and consumption opportunities shift from suburban to urban centers. This reallocation increases urban amenities but also raises urban land prices, while generating opposite effects in suburban areas. Decomposition shows that amenity improvements from consumption travel account for up to 72% of the total welfare gain, highlighting the contribution of this mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文使用智能手机GPS数据评估高速公路对城市内部出行的影响，发现高速公路成为出行障碍，导致跨高速和用高速的目的地选择概率分别降低24.9%和23.5%。通过城市模型模拟显示，消除这些障碍可带来至少9%的福利提升，主要源于消费出行便利性的改善。
AI.research_question: 高速公路如何影响城市内部出行选择？消除高速公路带来的出行障碍会产生怎样的福利效应？
AI.motivation: 理解交通基础设施对城市内部出行模式的影响，特别是高速公路作为物理和心理障碍对居民目的地选择行为的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市经济学理论、出行行为理论、集聚经济理论
AI.method: 使用细粒度智能手机GPS数据分析出行模式，构建整合工作和消费出行的定量城市模型进行反事实分析
AI.findings: 高速公路显著阻碍出行选择，跨高速目的地选择概率降低24.9%，使用高速目的地降低23.5%；短途消费出行受影响更大，通勤出行影响较小；消除障碍可带来至少9%的福利增益
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高速公路作为出行障碍的新机制，强调了消费出行在城市福利中的重要作用，拓展了城市交通基础设施影响的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市交通规划和高速公路改造提供实证依据，表明消除高速公路障碍可显著提升城市居民福利，促进城市中心区发展

title: Central Bank Communication and Biodiversity

detail.title: Central Bank Communication and Biodiversity
detail.abstract: Biodiversity loss has been identified as a driver of systemic financial risk, yet its integration into supervisory frameworks and central bank agendas remains nascent. This paper provides the first analysis of how biodiversity is addressed in central bank communication, drawing on over 11,000 speeches in the Bank for International Settlements database between 2012 and 2024. Using a hybrid natural language processing approach that combines dictionary filtering and semantic similarity scoring, I identify 141 biodiversity-related speeches, of which only 19 place biodiversity at the core of the discussion.The analysis reveals several key findings. First, biodiversity is largely absent from central bank discourse, appearing in less than 2% of speeches and overwhelmingly framed through climate-related risks. Second, when mentioned explicitly, recommendations remain limited to exploratory calls for improved data, disclosure, and risk metrics, without operational integration into supervisory tools. Third, discourse is highly uneven across jurisdictions, concentrated in a few European central banks, while most authorities remain silent.These findings point to a significant blind spot in financial stability agendas: despite ever-growing evidence that biodiversity loss may generate systemic risks comparable to climate change, the majority of central banks have yet to recognize biodiversity as a distinct and material source of financial vulnerability in their communication.

AI.tldr: 本文首次分析了央行沟通中如何讨论生物多样性问题，通过对BIS数据库中2012-2024年11,000多篇演讲的分析发现，生物多样性在央行话语中基本缺失，仅出现在不到2%的演讲中，且主要通过与气候相关风险的框架来讨论。
AI.research_question: 央行在沟通中如何讨论生物多样性问题？生物多样性在央行话语中的存在程度和框架方式如何？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性丧失已被确认为系统性金融风险的驱动因素，但其在监管框架和央行议程中的整合仍处于初级阶段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融稳定理论和系统性风险理论，探讨生物多样性作为金融脆弱性来源的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用混合自然语言处理方法，结合词典过滤和语义相似性评分，分析BIS数据库中11,000多篇央行演讲。
AI.findings: 1) 生物多样性在央行话语中基本缺失（<2%的演讲）；2) 讨论主要限于改进数据、披露和风险指标的探索性呼吁；3) 话语在不同司法管辖区高度不均衡，集中在少数欧洲央行。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生物多样性作为系统性金融风险来源的理论重要性，填补了金融稳定议程中的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和监管机构提供了实证证据，说明需要将生物多样性风险纳入金融稳定监测和监管工具中。

title: Behavioral Economics in High School Markets --Decoy Effect and The Profit Function
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Behavioral Economics in High School Markets --Decoy Effect and The Profit Function

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The experiment and research is based on the idea to increase the sales for school merchandise in order to boost the school spirit in the community.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research paper is not a sociology research, there's no ethical issues
declarations.funderStatement: Catlin gabel School provided the setting and product in the experiment.

detail.abstract: This research explores how behavioral economics theories, particularly the Decoy Effect, can be applied to real-life sales strategies within a high school setting. Conducted at Catlin Gabel School, the experiment tested merchandise pricing strategies by introducing a decoy item that aimed to dominate students' purchasing behavior. Sales data showed a significant increase from 23% to 78% in target purchases when the decoy was present. To quantify this effect, a profit function model was developed using key variables: original purchase probability (q₀), adjusted probability under influence (q₁), and decoy detection probability (δ). The findings highlight how consumer choices can be shaped by pricing structures and support the use of behavioral economics in school-based or small business sales planning. Limitations of decoy effect and future applications are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在高中学府应用行为经济学中的诱饵效应理论，实验证明引入诱饵商品能显著提升目标商品购买率从23%到78%，并建立了利润函数模型量化该效应。
AI.research_question: 行为经济学理论（特别是诱饵效应）如何应用于高中环境中的实际销售策略？
AI.motivation: 探索行为经济学理论在现实销售环境中的应用效果，特别是在学校场景中测试诱饵效应对学生购买行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论，特别是诱饵效应（Decoy Effect）理论，即通过引入一个相对不具吸引力的选项来改变消费者对原有选项的偏好。
AI.method: 在Catlin Gabel学校进行实地实验，测试商品定价策略，通过引入诱饵商品来主导学生购买行为，并收集销售数据进行量化分析。
AI.findings: 销售数据显示，当存在诱饵商品时，目标商品的购买率从23%显著提升至78%。建立了包含原始购买概率(q₀)、调整后概率(q₁)和诱饵检测概率(δ)的利润函数模型来量化效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了行为经济学理论在真实教育环境中的适用性，为诱饵效应提供了实证支持，并建立了量化分析模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校和小型企业提供了基于行为经济学的销售策略规划方法，展示了如何通过定价结构设计来影响消费者选择行为。

detail.title: Testing the Relationship between Socio-Political Factors, Economic Variables and Food Insecurity in Nigeria

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Conflict Resolution and Social | Issues Vol. 1 No. 1, December 2020

detail.abstract: The study investigates the prevalence of food insecurity, its determinants and the association of food insecurity with governance and socioeconomic factors in Nigeria. The study used secondary data for the period 1999 to 2018. The main method of analysis used for the work is Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL). The result of the ARDL bound testing shows that the null hypothesis of no cointegration is rejected. The ARDL cointegration form shows that there is statistically significant relationship between food insecurity and food price inflation, per capita income, economic growth and education. Negative relationship with per capita income means that higher per capita income reduces food insecurity. The study recommends a structural shift in the macroeconomic policies towards wealth and employment generation.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用ARDL方法分析尼日利亚1999-2018年数据，发现食品价格通胀、人均收入、经济增长和教育与粮食不安全存在显著统计关系，其中人均收入与粮食不安全呈负相关。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚粮食不安全的普遍程度、决定因素及其与治理和社会经济因素的关联是什么？
AI.motivation: 调查尼日利亚粮食不安全问题，分析其影响因素，为制定有效的粮食安全政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于粮食安全理论和经济发展理论，探讨经济因素与粮食安全的关系。
AI.method: 使用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型分析1999-2018年的二手数据。
AI.findings: ARDL边界检验拒绝无协整关系的原假设；食品价格通胀、人均收入、经济增长和教育与粮食不安全存在显著统计关系；人均收入与粮食不安全呈负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了经济发展理论在粮食安全领域的适用性，为粮食安全研究提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议宏观经济政策向财富创造和就业生成进行结构性转变，为尼日利亚粮食安全政策制定提供具体指导。

title: Towards Comprehensive Medical Leave Legislation: Ensuring Health Rights in Bangladeshi Workplaces

detail.title: Towards Comprehensive Medical Leave Legislation: Ensuring Health Rights in Bangladeshi Workplaces
detail.abstract: The right to health is a cornerstone of human dignity and productivity. However, in Bangladesh, workplace medical leave is still largely treated as a privilege rather than a statutory entitlement. While the Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006, provides for limited sick leave, its scope remains confined to industrial workers, excluding the majority of professionals in education, services, and non-governmental sectors. This paper critically examines the absence of a comprehensive legal framework on medical leave in Bangladesh. Drawing on International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions, constitutional provisions, and comparative jurisprudence, it argues for immediate legislative reform. Particular attention is paid to environmental and occupational health challenges, socioeconomic implications, and the binding nature of Bangladesh's international commitments under instruments such as the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR). Ultimately, the paper calls for the recognition of medical leave as a legally enforceable right for all workers, thereby advancing justice, health, and sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析孟加拉国缺乏全面医疗休假法律框架的问题，基于国际劳工标准、宪法规定和比较法理，呼吁将医疗休假确立为所有工人的法定权利。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国为何缺乏全面的医疗休假法律框架？如何通过立法改革将医疗休假确立为所有工人的法定权利？
AI.motivation: 医疗休假是人权尊严和生产力的基石，但在孟加拉国仍被视为特权而非法定权利，现行法律仅覆盖产业工人，排除了教育、服务和NGO等大多数专业人士。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际劳工组织公约、宪法规定、比较法理学、国际经社文权利公约等国际承诺的法律约束力。
AI.method: 批判性法律分析，基于国际劳工标准、宪法条款和比较 jurisprudence 的规范性研究。
AI.findings: 现行法律框架存在重大缺陷，仅限于产业工人，缺乏全面覆盖；国际承诺具有法律约束力但未充分转化为国内法；环境与职业健康挑战凸显立法紧迫性。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了工作权与健康权交叉领域的理论框架，强化了国际人权标准在国内法实施中的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法改革提供具体建议，推动将医疗休假确立为所有工人的可强制执行法定权利，促进社会正义、健康和可持续发展。

title: Reassessing the Strength of Industrial Banks: Evidence, Trends, and Policy Implications
affiliations: University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business, University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business and Northeastern University

detail.title: Reassessing the Strength of Industrial Banks: Evidence, Trends, and Policy Implications

declarations.funderStatement: Stena Center for Financial Technology provided funding for the project.

detail.abstract: Industrial banks (IB) are state-chartered, FDIC-insured institutions that commercial or financial parents may own, and they occupy a distinctive niche in the U.S. banking system. We document that IBs differ from other FDIC-insured banks along three core margins: (i) ownership and supervision (CALMA/PCA commitments that contractually obligate parents to act as sources of strength), (ii) business models (specialized, often nationally distributed lending with heavy use of brokered deposits), and (iii) performance and resilience. From 2000 to 2025, we demonstrate that IBs-especially those with commercial parents-exhibit persistently higher ROA/ROE and stronger capitalization than other banks. Critically, this exists even during the Global Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 shock. IB funding relies disproportionately on (insured) brokered deposits and higher capitalization. As a result, IB failures are rare and small in aggregate relative to the broader system. IBs have niche business models that lead them to decrease market concentration and enable them to increase product innovation. Their market segments focus on specialized and underserved segments, often using information advantages from their parent company. We discuss the policy tradeoffs of layering additional regulation onto a framework in which FDIC/state oversight already mirrors that of comparable banks. We find little evidence that restrictions on commercial ownership would deliver stability benefits, but that they could increase compliance and innovation costs.

AI.tldr: 工业银行在美国银行体系中具有独特地位，研究发现其相比其他银行在所有权监管、商业模式和绩效韧性方面表现更优，特别是在危机期间仍保持较高盈利能力和资本充足率，政策上不建议增加额外监管限制。
AI.research_question: 工业银行与其他FDIC保险银行在核心特征、绩效表现和政策监管方面存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: 工业银行作为美国银行体系中的特殊存在，其独特的监管框架和商业模式需要系统性研究，以评估其稳定性和政策适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行监管理论、商业模式理论和金融稳定性理论，分析工业银行的特殊监管安排和业务模式对其绩效的影响。
AI.method: 实证分析方法，使用2000-2025年期间的数据，比较工业银行与其他FDIC保险银行在财务指标、风险特征和市场表现等方面的差异。
AI.findings: 工业银行（特别是商业母公司控股的）表现出持续更高的ROA/ROE和更强的资本充足率，即使在全球金融危机和COVID-19冲击期间也是如此；依赖经纪存款和更高资本化使其失败率低且规模小；通过专业化商业模式降低市场集中度并促进产品创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了特殊银行机构监管理论，提供了工业银行独特商业模式与绩效关系的实证证据，深化了对非传统银行机构稳定性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供政策建议，表明对工业银行增加额外监管限制可能不会带来稳定性收益，反而会增加合规和创新成本；为投资者识别稳健银行投资标的提供参考。

title: Effect of Rice Husk and Bamboo Biochar on Soil Compaction in Paddy Fields under Varying Moisture Conditions
affiliations: Syiah Kuala University, Syiah Kuala University and Syiah Kuala University

detail.title: Effect of Rice Husk and Bamboo Biochar on Soil Compaction in Paddy Fields under Varying Moisture Conditions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Mediterranean Journal of Basic and Applied Sciences, volume 09, issue 03, 2025[10.46382/MJBAS.2025.9307]

detail.abstract: Soil compaction impacts the physical quality of paddy fields by hindering water infiltration, limiting aeration, and stunting root growth. The use of biochar has emerged as a promising approach to mitigate soil compaction and improve soil structure. This study aimed to investigate the effects of rice husk and petung bamboo biochar on soil compaction at different moisture levels. Laboratory assays employing standard compaction tests of soils were performed, and the resulting data were subjected to quadratic regression analysis. Both rice husk and petung bamboo biochars showed a quadratic relationship between soil moisture and compaction with R² values of 0.8512 and 0.9913, respectively. Also, rice husk biochar lowered soil compaction so that bulk density decreased from 1.393937 g.cm⁻³ at 27%(w/w) moisture to 1.2006 g.cm⁻³ at 41% (w/w) moisture. Meanwhile, soil with petung bamboo biochar reached a maximum bulk density of 1.3806 g.cm⁻³ at 36% (w/w) moisture and was stable at higher moistures. The effectiveness of biochars in reducing soil compaction is attributed to their physical properties such as porosity and density. From the results, it is suggested that the application of rice husk biochar effectively improves paddy field soil structure and supports sustainable agriculture practices.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验室标准压实试验，探究稻壳和petung竹生物炭在不同湿度水平下对土壤压实的影响。两种生物炭均显示土壤湿度与压实度存在二次关系，稻壳生物炭能有效降低土壤容重，改善稻田土壤结构。
AI.research_question: 稻壳和petung竹生物炭在不同湿度条件下如何影响土壤压实度？
AI.motivation: 土壤压实影响稻田物理质量，阻碍水分渗透、限制通气并抑制根系生长，需要寻找有效的缓解方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物炭物理特性（孔隙度和密度）对土壤结构改善的理论机制
AI.method: 实验室标准压实试验，采用二次回归分析处理数据
AI.findings: 两种生物炭均显示土壤湿度与压实度的二次关系（R²分别为0.8512和0.9913）；稻壳生物炭使容重从1.393937 g.cm⁻³降至1.2006 g.cm⁻³；竹生物炭在36%湿度时达到最大容重1.3806 g.cm⁻³
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了生物炭通过其物理特性（孔隙度和密度）有效减少土壤压实的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善稻田土壤结构、支持可持续农业实践提供了稻壳生物炭应用的具体方案

title: The Proliferation of Unilateral Trade Measures and the Crisis of the Multilateral Trading System
affiliations: NingboTech University - School of Law

detail.title: The Proliferation of Unilateral Trade Measures and the Crisis of the Multilateral Trading System
detail.abstract: Following President Trump's assumption of office at the start of the year, he introduced a series of tariff measures. These unilateral trade actions, especially the reciprocal tariffs, could have profound and far-reaching consequences, potentially undermining the very foundations of the multilateral trading system. This is due to their direct challenge to the Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) principle, a cornerstone of the World Trade Organization (WTO). Additionally, the unilateral trade measures imposed by the United States have triggered follow-up actions from other nations, resulting in reciprocal countermeasures. It is critical to determine how to respond to reciprocal tariffs in a manner that preserves the integrity of the multilateral trading system. Special attention must be given to the creation of a complex network of bilateral agreements, formed through bilateral consultations after the implementation of US reciprocal tariffs, which may indirectly weaken the multilateral framework.

AI.tldr: 特朗普政府的单边关税措施，特别是互惠关税，对WTO最惠国待遇原则构成直接挑战，可能破坏多边贸易体系基础，并引发其他国家的报复性措施。需要研究如何在应对互惠关税时维护多边贸易体系的完整性，特别关注双边协议网络对多边框架的潜在削弱作用。
AI.research_question: 如何应对互惠关税以维护多边贸易体系的完整性？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府实施的单边贸易措施，特别是互惠关税，直接挑战WTO最惠国待遇原则，可能破坏多边贸易体系基础，并引发其他国家的报复性行动，亟需研究应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于WTO多边贸易体系理论，特别是最惠国待遇原则，分析互惠关税对多边框架的冲击。
AI.method: 理论分析和政策研究，通过分析美国单边关税措施及其引发的连锁反应，探讨对多边贸易体系的影响。
AI.findings: 互惠关税措施直接挑战MFN原则，引发各国报复性措施，双边协商形成的协议网络可能间接削弱多边贸易框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对互惠关税破坏多边贸易体系机制的理解，为维护WTO原则提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供应对互惠关税、维护多边贸易体系完整性的策略建议，避免双边协议网络对多边框架的侵蚀。

title: The Impact of COVID-19 Pandemic on Malaysian Stock Performance
affiliations: Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS) - Faculty of Economics and Business, Universiti Malaysia Sarawak and Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS) - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: The Impact of COVID-19 Pandemic on Malaysian Stock Performance
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic occurs in year 2020 bring huge impact in worldwide. The global stock market was affected by the COVID-19 pandemic including Malaysia's stock market. The purpose of this study is to determine the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on Malaysian stock performance. This study will employ the Kendall's tau-b correlation analysis to determine the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. The data collected are daily data from 25 th January 2025 to 31 st December 2025. The dependent variable is the Kuala Lumpur Composite Index (KLCI) while the independent variables are built up from two categories which are the COVID-19 variables and the control variables. The COVID-19 variables include the confirmed cases, death cases and recovery cases. On the other hand, the control variables include the oil price, gold price, exchange rate, volatility index and NASDAQ composite index. The result showed the COVID-19 variables had significant impact on KLCI.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用Kendall's tau-b相关分析探讨COVID-19疫情对马来西亚股市的影响，发现确诊病例、死亡病例和康复病例等疫情变量对吉隆坡综合指数(KLCI)有显著影响。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情对马来西亚股市表现有何影响？
AI.motivation: 2020年COVID-19疫情对全球股市产生重大影响，包括马来西亚股市，需要研究疫情对马来西亚股市的具体影响。

title: The Role of Financial Traders for Price Responses to Shocks in the Commodity Futures Markets
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration

detail.title: The Role of Financial Traders for Price Responses to Shocks in the Commodity Futures Markets
detail.abstract: I investigate the conditions under which financial traders amplify price responses to significant spot market price changes in 13 agricultural commodity futures markets. Financial traders dampen price changes during the Russia-Ukraine war but amplify them during the Global Financial Crisis. However, this mitigating effect depends on the market share of financial traders: as their market share grows, the mitigation effect weakens and eventually reverses, leading to amplified price changes. According to hedging pressure theory, financial traders help dampen price changes by providing liquidity to commercial hedgers in exchange for earning a risk premium. By identifying when they cease to act as liquidity providers, I offer robust support for the hypothesis that financial traders may amplify price changes under specific conditions.

AI.tldr: 金融交易者在不同市场条件下对农产品期货价格变化的影响不同：在俄乌战争期间抑制价格波动，但在全球金融危机期间放大价格波动。这种影响取决于金融交易者的市场份额，市场份额增大时抑制效应减弱并最终转为放大效应。
AI.research_question: 金融交易者在什么条件下会放大现货市场价格重大变化的价格反应？
AI.motivation: 研究金融交易者在农产品期货市场中的角色，特别是他们何时从流动性提供者转变为价格波动的放大器，这对于理解市场稳定性和风险管理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 套期保值压力理论 - 金融交易者通过为商业套期保值者提供流动性来赚取风险溢价，从而抑制价格变化。
AI.method: 对13个农产品期货市场进行分析，研究金融交易者在不同市场事件（俄乌战争、全球金融危机）中的行为差异，并考察市场份额对效应的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 金融交易者在俄乌战争期间抑制价格变化，但在全球金融危机期间放大价格变化；2) 抑制效应取决于金融交易者的市场份额，市场份额增长时抑制效应减弱并最终逆转；3) 提供了金融交易者在特定条件下放大价格变化的实证证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 为套期保值压力理论提供了重要补充，明确了金融交易者从流动性提供者向价格波动放大器转变的具体条件，丰富了市场微观结构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场监管者和市场参与者提供了重要参考：1) 需要关注金融交易者的市场份额阈值；2) 在不同市场环境下制定差异化的风险管理策略；3) 为农产品期货市场的稳定运行提供政策建议。

title:
Towards a Unified Theory of Identity-Based Denialism: Confirmation Bias as a Multicausal Axis 
(Hacia una teoría unificada del negacionismo identitario: El Sesgo de Confirmación Como Eje Multicausal)

detail.title:
Towards a Unified Theory of Identity-Based Denialism: Confirmation Bias as a Multicausal Axis 
(Hacia una teoría unificada del negacionismo identitario: El Sesgo de Confirmación Como Eje Multicausal)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This theoretical study did not involve human participants or animals and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a multicausal framework to explain the transition from critical skepticism to identity-based denialism, positioning confirmation bias (CB) as the central organizing axis. The framework argues that CB does not operate in isolation but as a cross-level mechanism that integrates biological, cognitive, relational, and structural factors. These include behavioral genetics, epigenetics, immunogenetics, attributional and cognitive styles, epistemic subcultures, homophily, symbolic belonging, and pro-engagement algorithms. The model reframes denialism, or organized cognitive resistance, not as a simple information deficit but as a practice of identity and belonging, which accounts for its persistence in the face of contradictory evidence. The paper derives core and exploratory hypotheses and outlines their operationalization through psychometric scales, experimental paradigms, digital trace analyses, and biomarkers, with an emphasis on longitudinal designs and confounding control. The implications of this research are organized across several key areas: education (metacognitive literacy), public policy (algorithmic transparency and auditing), science (openness and self-critique), organizational management (preventing epistemic closure), and interdisciplinarity. The analysis concludes that displacing confirmation bias from its dominant role is a necessary condition for restoring genuinely open critical thinking, which is indispensable for countering the consolidation of denialist movements in polarized, platform-mediated publics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多因果框架来解释从批判性怀疑主义到基于身份的否认主义的转变，将确认偏误作为核心组织轴心。该框架认为确认偏误不是孤立运作的，而是作为跨层次机制整合生物、认知、关系和结构因素。
AI.research_question: 如何解释从批判性怀疑主义向身份性否认主义的转变过程？确认偏误在这一过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解否认主义（有组织的认知抵抗）为何在面对矛盾证据时仍然持续存在，以及如何解释这种认知现象的顽固性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多因果框架，以确认偏误为核心组织轴心，整合行为遗传学、表观遗传学、免疫遗传学、归因和认知风格、认识论亚文化、同质性、符号归属和促参与算法等多个理论视角。
AI.method: 心理测量量表、实验范式、数字痕迹分析和生物标志物测量，强调纵向设计和混杂因素控制。
AI.findings: 否认主义不是简单的信息缺失，而是一种身份和归属实践，确认偏误作为跨层次机制整合了多层面因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新构建了否认主义的概念框架，提出了确认偏误作为核心机制的多层次整合模型，为理解认知抵抗提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 在教育（元认知素养）、公共政策（算法透明度和审计）、科学（开放性和自我批判）、组织管理（防止认识论封闭）和跨学科合作等多个领域提供了实践指导。

title: WTO Trade Dispute Mechanism Is More Power-Based Than Rule-Based

detail.title: WTO Trade Dispute Mechanism Is More Power-Based Than Rule-Based
detail.abstract: The World Trade Organization (WTO) dispute settlement mechanism was designed to provide a rule-based framework for resolving international trade conflicts, ensuring fairness, predictability, and equality among members. However, in practice, the system often reflects the power asymmetries between developed and developing nations. This paper critically examines the extent to which the WTO dispute mechanism is power-based rather than genuinely rule-based. Drawing on recent case law, trade disputes, and the challenges faced by weaker economies, the analysis demonstrates that while the formal structure appears neutral, outcomes frequently favour states with greater economic, political, and legal capacity. Key deficiencies, including limited access to resources for developing countries, the politicization of rulings, and enforcement asymmetries, highlight systemic inequalities. The paper concludes that unless reforms address these imbalances, the WTO will continue to reinforce existing power structures rather than serve as a truly impartial arbiter of trade disputes. Recommendations include strengthening support for developing states, enhancing compliance mechanisms, and ensuring that the principles of fairness and inclusivity underpin global trade governance.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析WTO争端解决机制，指出其表面规则导向实则权力导向的本质，揭示了发达国家与发展中国家之间的权力不对称如何影响争端解决结果，并提出了改革建议。
AI.research_question: WTO争端解决机制在多大程度上是基于权力而非真正基于规则的？
AI.motivation: WTO争端解决机制旨在提供基于规则的国际贸易冲突解决框架，但实践中往往反映了发达国家与发展中国家之间的权力不对称，需要批判性检验其实际运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的权力不对称理论、国际法执行理论、发展中国家在国际制度中的边缘化理论
AI.method: 基于近期案例法、贸易争端分析以及弱势经济体面临的挑战进行批判性分析
AI.findings: 尽管WTO争端解决机制形式结构看似中立，但结果往往偏向具有更强经济、政治和法律能力的国家；发展中国家资源获取有限、裁决政治化和执行不对称等关键缺陷凸显了系统性不平等
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对国际制度中权力不对称如何影响规则执行的理解，为国际关系和国际法交叉研究提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体改革建议：加强对发展中国家的支持、增强合规机制、确保公平和包容性原则支撑全球贸易治理，为WTO机制改革提供政策指导

title: Enhancing Fiscal Stability through Medium-Term Tax Strategies and Inflation-Adaptive Policies

detail.title: Enhancing Fiscal Stability through Medium-Term Tax Strategies and Inflation-Adaptive Policies
detail.abstract: Amid persistent macroeconomic volatility and inflationary pressures, international financial institutions have increasingly underscored the importance of fiscal consolidation as a cornerstone for sustainable public finance. Central to this objective is the adoption of mediumterm budgetary frameworks (MTBFs) featuring medium-term revenue strategies (MTRSs), which promote a coordinated, multi-year approach to tax reform that integrates policy design, administration, and legal structures. This paper examines the efficacy of medium-term tax plans, targeting the excisable goods market (e.g., alcohol, sugar-sweetened beverages, tobacco, fuel), by constructing a theoretical model comparing government revenue outcomes under a six-year rule-based plan with steady annual rate increases, against alternative biennial and triennial ad hoc tax adjustment scenarios. Furthermore, the analysis considers the revenue implications of indexation mechanisms (i.e., the automatic adjustment of tax rates to a select inflationary benchmark). Findings indicate that formal multi-year tax plans with scheduled annual increases markedly improve revenue stability and accumulation compared to ad hoc revisions. While indexation remains a useful mechanism for preserving the real value of revenues, it does not facilitate real revenue growth, underscoring the necessity for a dual strategy: utilizing indexation as a baseline safeguard to maintain the real value of revenues in inflationary settings, combined with formal multi-year tax plans. This dual policy allows governments to achieve real revenue growth, enhancing fiscal stability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论模型比较了六年期规则性税收计划与临时性税收调整方案的效果，发现多年期税收计划能显著改善收入稳定性和积累，建议将指数化机制作为基础保障，结合正式多年期税收计划实现实际收入增长。
AI.research_question: 中期税收计划（特别是针对应税商品市场）在提高政府收入稳定性和积累方面的效果如何？与临时性税收调整相比有何优势？
AI.motivation: 在宏观经济波动和通胀压力持续的背景下，国际金融机构强调财政整顿对可持续公共财政的重要性，需要研究中期预算框架下的税收策略有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建理论模型比较不同税收调整方案（六年期规则性计划vs两年期/三年期临时调整）的收入效果，并分析指数化机制的作用。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过构建模型比较不同税收调整情景下的政府收入结果，特别关注应税商品市场（酒精、含糖饮料、烟草、燃料等）。
AI.findings: 正式多年期税收计划（按计划年度增加税率）相比临时性修订能显著改善收入稳定性和积累；指数化机制能保持收入实际价值但不促进实际收入增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了双重策略理论框架：将指数化作为通胀环境下保持收入实际价值的基础保障，结合正式多年期税收计划实现实际收入增长。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府提供了具体的政策建议：采用指数化机制结合正式多年期税收计划的双重策略，可以增强财政稳定性，实现实际收入增长。

title: Energy Standard

detail.title: Energy Standard
detail.abstract: A currency backed by electricity, through its direct linkage to the watt-hour (Wh), issued at the moment of energy transmission and extinguished upon payment for electricity, offers not only internal economic and monetary stability but also a profound rethinking of economic thought. The integration of economics with the exact sciences, such as physics, fosters an expanded, interdisciplinary, and precise body of economic knowledge, enabling more accurate and efficient economic governance. The vulnerability of such a currency in foreign trade is addressed through the introduction of a dual-currency system, in which an external fiat currency functions as an intermediary layer, providing protection against manipulations in international exchange.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以电力为基础的新型货币体系，通过瓦时直接挂钩实现经济稳定，并引入双货币系统解决国际贸易中的脆弱性问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种基于电力的稳定货币体系，既能实现内部经济稳定，又能有效应对国际贸易中的汇率操纵风险？
AI.motivation: 传统法币体系存在不稳定性和易受操纵的问题，需要寻找一种与实体经济直接挂钩的稳定货币基础，电力作为基础能源具有普遍性和可量化特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币理论、能源经济学、物理学与经济学交叉学科框架、双货币体系理论
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析，通过电力与货币的直接挂钩机制设计，以及双货币系统的架构设计
AI.findings: 电力背书货币能够提供内部经济稳定性，通过瓦时直接挂钩实现价值稳定；双货币系统可以有效保护国内经济免受国际汇率操纵的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了电力背书货币的新理论框架，发展了物理学与经济学交叉学科的理论基础，完善了双货币体系的理论构建
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国央行提供了新型货币体系的设计方案，为能源丰富的国家提供了货币稳定化的实践路径，为国际贸易提供了汇率风险防范的新机制

title: The 2024 Patent Valuation and Damages Workshop: A US-China Comparative Law Perspective
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Minnesota Law School, Peking University - Law School, Tsinghua University School of Law, Peking University - Peking University Law School, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Shanghai Jiaotong University, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (CASS) - Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (CASS), Graduate School of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, Students, East China University of Political Science and Law, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Shanghai Jiaotong University, University of California, Berkeley - School of Law and Berkeley Centre for Law and Technology

detail.title: The 2024 Patent Valuation and Damages Workshop: A US-China Comparative Law Perspective
detail.abstract: This report summarizes the proceedings of the 2024 Patent Valuation and Damages Workshop: A U.S.–China Comparative Law Perspective, jointly organized by the Berkeley Asia IP & Competition Law Center (BAIC), Berkeley Center for Law and Technology (BCLT), KoGuan School of Law at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and the Institute of Intellectual Property and Competition Law. Held in Shanghai on May 28, 2024, the workshop convened leading judges, scholars, practitioners, in-house counsel, and economists from both countries to examine the evolving frameworks for patent damages and valuation. As the inaugural workshop on patent law and practice from a U.S.–China comparative perspective, pioneered by BAIC and BCLT, it explored compensatory damages (lost profits, reasonable royalties, price erosion, apportionment), punitive damages and their deterrence effects, the challenges of valuing and licensing standard-essential patents (SEPs), and the “important but limited” role of judicial rate setting in shaping technology markets. With attention to both theoretical underpinnings and practical case studies, the report highlights key similarities and divergences in practice, as well as the implications for global patent litigation and licensing. By capturing this pioneering comparative dialogue, the report provides valuable insight into the jurisprudential evolution of patent remedies and their broader policy context in the world’s two largest innovation economies.

AI.tldr: 2024年中美专利估值与损害赔偿研讨会报告，比较两国专利损害赔偿框架、惩罚性赔偿、标准必要专利估值等关键议题
AI.research_question: 中美专利损害赔偿与估值制度在理论框架和实践应用方面存在哪些异同？这些差异对全球专利诉讼和许可有何影响？
AI.motivation: 作为首个从中美比较法视角探讨专利法与实务的研讨会，旨在促进两国在专利损害赔偿和估值方面的对话与理解
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利损害赔偿理论（补偿性赔偿、惩罚性赔偿）、标准必要专利FRAND原则、司法费率设定理论
AI.method: 研讨会形式，汇集法官、学者、从业者、企业法务和经济学家进行跨学科对话，结合理论探讨和实际案例分析
AI.findings: 识别了中美专利损害赔偿实践中的关键相似点和差异点，探讨了惩罚性赔偿的威慑效应，分析了标准必要专利估值挑战和司法费率设定的有限作用
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了中美专利损害赔偿比较分析的理论框架，推动了专利救济法理学的跨国对话
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球专利诉讼和许可实践提供参考，促进中美知识产权保护体系的相互理解和协调

title: Quantum Social Lensing Codes as Qusole Codes
affiliations: University of Victoria and University of Victoria

detail.title: Quantum Social Lensing Codes as Qusole Codes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The authors confirm there is no violation of ethics in this research. No patients/participants were involved, and all cases mentioned are based on cited research and/or simulations already published by peer-reviewed journals.
declarations.funderStatement: This work constitutes a PhD dissertation chapter already defended by the current author(s) to assess sustainable development goals (SDGs) claims within this research, as supported by the funder of the project, the University of Victoria, Grant # V0766282 to the authors of the Quantum Field Lens Coding (QFLC) project. The dissertation abstract, pointing out the societal impact examples, is available at https://www.uvic.ca/graduatestudies/oral-exams/exam-candidates/data/philip-baback-alipour.php#ipn-abstract

detail.abstract: Societies focus on global (un)sustainable goals by producing N events to achieve a desired target state (TS). This TS is a social lensing (SoLe) vector, which describes an event impacting societies on a quantum-to-macro (qubit → N fields) scale. Employing a quantum double-field (QDF) algorithm can simulate physical systems, predicting events with high probability. The probability of a state transition (ST) doubles in prediction values of N events: ST probabilities of ≥ 1∕N into (2N∕3) ≥ 2∕3 from N QDFs. Examples are preventing misinformation spread (cybersecurity threats) by making strong predictions through (de)focusing state distribution of events from a QDF, as a quantum SoLe (Qusole) method. A QDF dataset is used to make strong predictions via quantum field lens coding (QFLC) and AI. The QFLC algorithm from the dataset classifies and predicts events at the observer's decision points to see which data point projects the next events. For example, in medicine, reconstruct damaged DNA strands to predict a virus/cancer cell target, its spread and growth against healthy cells. In law, identify forged documents from genuine ones via QDF's. Societal impacts, goals, and examples are outlined to propose a sustainable global environment by the Qusole application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子双场算法(QDF)和社会透镜向量(SoLe)方法，通过量子场透镜编码(QFLC)和AI预测事件概率，应用于网络安全、医学和法律等领域，旨在实现可持续全球环境。
AI.research_question: 如何利用量子双场算法和社会透镜向量方法来预测事件并实现可持续的全球目标？
AI.motivation: 社会需要有效的方法来预测和应对全球可持续性挑战，如网络安全威胁、医疗问题和法律伪造等，传统方法在预测精度和效率方面存在局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于量子计算理论和社会透镜(SoLe)向量概念，构建量子双场(QDF)算法框架，将量子态转换概率应用于宏观社会事件预测。
AI.method: 采用量子场透镜编码(QFLC)算法，利用QDF数据集进行分类和预测，通过(defocusing状态分布来增强预测能力，状态转换概率从≥1/N提升到(2N/3)≥2/3。
AI.findings: QDF算法能够以高概率预测事件，在网络安全中可防止错误信息传播，在医学中可预测病毒/癌细胞目标，在法律中可识别伪造文件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了量子社会透镜(Qusole)方法，将量子计算原理扩展到社会事件预测领域，建立了量子-宏观尺度的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可应用于多个领域的实用预测工具，包括网络安全威胁检测、医学诊断预测和法律文件验证，为实现可持续全球环境提供了技术方案。

title: A Comprehensive Real-Time Quantitative Framework for Option Pricing: Mathematical Foundations and Practical Implementation of the Heston Stochastic Volatility Model with Gauss-Legendre Quadrature

detail.title: A Comprehensive Real-Time Quantitative Framework for Option Pricing: Mathematical Foundations and Practical Implementation of the Heston Stochastic Volatility Model with Gauss-Legendre Quadrature
detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive quantitative framework for real-time option pricing that integrates the Heston stochastic volatility model with Gauss-Legendre quadrature methods and live market data acquisition. We develop a complete mathematical foundation starting from the fundamental principles of geometric Brownian motion and stochastic calculus, progressing through the derivation of the Black-Scholes equation and its limitations, and culminating in the rigorous mathematical development of the Heston model. The framework employs the numerically stable Little-Trap formulation of the Heston characteristic function and utilizes Gauss-Legendre quadrature for efficient Fourier inversion, achieving convergence to within 10-6 accuracy using 64 quadrature nodes. Our implementation includes comprehensive data acquisition capabilities through modern financial APIs, automated put-call parity validation, and extensive convergence analysis. Empirical testing using live market data from major equity indices (SPY, AAPL, TSLA, AMZN, GOOG) demonstrates that Heston prices can exceed Black-Scholes by several hundred percent for in-the-money options while maintaining positive values for deep out-of-the-money strikes where Black-Scholes approaches zero, effectively capturing the volatility skew and tail-risk premium characteristic of real option markets. The framework provides a robust foundation for quantitative finance applications, algorithmic trading strategies, and risk management systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合Heston随机波动率模型、高斯-勒让德求积方法和实时市场数据采集的实时期权定价量化框架，通过数学推导和实证测试证明了Heston模型相比Black-Scholes模型在捕捉波动率偏斜和尾部风险溢价方面的优越性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个集成Heston随机波动率模型和高斯-勒让德求积方法的实时期权定价框架，并验证其在真实市场环境中的定价准确性和实用性？
AI.motivation: 传统Black-Scholes模型无法有效捕捉市场波动率偏斜和尾部风险溢价，需要开发更精确的随机波动率模型来满足量化金融和算法交易的实时定价需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于几何布朗运动、随机微积分、Black-Scholes方程和Heston随机波动率模型的理论基础，采用Little-Trap形式的Heston特征函数和傅里叶反演技术。
AI.method: 使用高斯-勒让德求积方法进行数值计算，采用64个求积节点实现10-6精度的收敛，通过现代金融API获取实时市场数据，进行自动化的看跌-看涨平价验证和收敛性分析。
AI.findings: 实证测试显示Heston模型定价可比Black-Scholes模型高出数百个百分点（对于实值期权），同时对深度虚值期权保持正值定价，有效捕捉了真实期权市场的波动率偏斜和尾部风险溢价特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了完整的Heston模型数学推导框架，提出了数值稳定的Little-Trap特征函数实现方法，验证了高斯-勒让德求积在期权定价中的高效性和准确性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了具有实时数据采集能力的期权定价系统，为量化金融应用、算法交易策略和风险管理体系提供了可靠的技术基础，可直接应用于实际交易环境。

title: The Snowden Leaks: An Analysis of Privacy, Security, and Democratic Accountability

detail.title: The Snowden Leaks: An Analysis of Privacy, Security, and Democratic Accountability
detail.abstract: This paper will cover the ethical, social, and political decisions and effects from 2013 revolving around Edward Snowden's leaks about U.S. government investigations. Covering a perspective from journalism, political communication, law, and international relations, I shall be discussing the support Edward Snowden received and the systems of government that supported him with the collected reforms, and what their assumptions are. The study provides a deep examination of the shift in the attitudes of the world-population towards the government and its functioning. This acknowledged change had a direct correlation to the modern inquiries about the functions and responsibilities of intelligence in open societies. By tracking the local and international impact of such revelations, the paper will discuss how these societal actions helped in sharp rethinking of policies and role transparency can have in democracies. The research states that when it comes to privacy rights and public debate, the political price for the action was fully worth it. The Department of Homeland Security defines a whistleblower as someone that performs an important service by reporting what they reasonably believe to be evidence of waste, fraud, abuse, or mismanagement (DHS). This is exactly what Edward Snowden did. In 2013 Edward Joseph Snowden went to Hong Kong and leaked thousands of top-secret documents about U.S. intelligence agencies' surveillance of American citizens to 3 journalists (Davies, 2019). By doing so Andrew Mitrovica, editor Al Jazeera, calls Snowden's leaks a courageous act because Snowden knew the blunt, life-altering risks he faced for sharing with the world the covert, often illegal, work done by spies at the National Security Agency (Mitrovica, 2022).

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了斯诺登事件的伦理、社会和政治影响，研究世界公众对政府态度的转变，以及这些曝光如何促使政策重新思考和推动漏洞透明度。
AI.research_question: 斯诺登曝光事件如何影响全球公众对政府态度的转变，以及这些社会行动如何促使政策重新思考和推动漏洞透明度在民主社会中的作用？
AI.motivation: 分析2013年斯诺登曝光美国政府监控调查的伦理、社会和政治决定与影响，以及这些曝光如何引发对开政社会中情报机构功能和责任的现代化询。
AI.theoretical_framework: 记者学、政治传播学、法学、国际关系理论，漏洞者保护理论，隐私权理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法，通过跟踪本土和国际影响来分析曝光事件的社会效应

title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Nigeria’s Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) in Enhancing SME Financial Sustainability
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Nigeria’s Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) in Enhancing SME Financial Sustainability
detail.abstract: The increasing reliance on digital tax systems in emerging economies has positioned Nigeria's Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS), particularly the TaxPro-Max platform, as a strategic tool for improving tax compliance and enhancing the sustainability of small and mediumsized enterprises (SMEs). This study evaluates the effectiveness of ITAS in reducing compliance costs, improving voluntary compliance, and fostering SME financial sustainability in Nigeria. A mixed-method research design was employed, combining quantitative data from 400 registered SMEs with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) and qualitative insights from in-depth interviews with Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS) officials. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, correlation, regression, and thematic analysis. Findings reveal that ITAS adoption significantly reduces compliance costs and administrative burdens, which positively influence voluntary compliance among SMEs. Furthermore, voluntary compliance mediates the relationship between ITAS adoption and SME financial sustainability, thereby strengthening SMEs' growth potential, profitability, and long-term survival. However, challenges such as poor internet infrastructure, limited digital literacy, and resistance to technological change hinder optimal system effectiveness. The study concludes that ITAS is a critical driver of sustainable tax compliance and SME resilience in Nigeria, provided its implementation challenges are addressed. It recommends targeted taxpayer sensitization, infrastructural support, and continuous system upgrades to enhance the efficiency of ITAS and the financial sustainability of SMEs.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚ITAS税收系统通过降低合规成本和提高自愿合规性，显著促进中小企业财务可持续性，但面临基础设施和数字素养等挑战。
AI.research_question: ITAS税收管理系统在降低合规成本、提高自愿合规性和促进中小企业财务可持续性方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体日益依赖数字税收系统，尼日利亚的ITAS系统作为改善税收合规和中小企业可持续性的战略工具具有重要意义。
